english: Your honor is assured in the tribe.  You claim many deaths in Zul'Gurub.  Enemies fall before your convictions.  Enemies fall before your power.$B$BThis is the freethinker's belt.  It is a symbol of honor.  It is powerful mojo.  It is now yours.
old_奖励清单: 你将获得部族的尊敬。你血洗了祖尔格拉布。敌人在你的信念前倒下。敌人因你的力量而死。$B$B这是思考者腰带。它是荣誉的象征。它是强大的魔精。现在它属于你了。
new_译文: 你在部族中的荣誉已无可置疑。你在祖尔格拉布取下无数性命。敌人在你的信念前倒下，敌人在你的力量前倒下。$B$B这是思考者腰带。它是荣誉的象征。它是强大的魔精。现在，它归你了。

english: You've done well, $N. Take your pick of hand protection in thanks for your efforts.
old_奖励清单: 你可以从这些奖励中选择其一：亡灵净化手套、亡灵毁灭裹手、亡灵毁灭护手、亡灵毁灭手套
new_译文: 干得不错，$N。挑一副护手吧，聊表谢意。

english: I hope that you will find these items useful in future battles.
old_奖励清单: 你将获得：神圣巫师之油
new_译文: 愿这些物品能在往后的战斗里帮上你的忙。

english: Thank you, $N. Here are your consecrated sharpening stones. Use them prudently.
old_奖励清单: 你将获得：神圣磨刀石
new_译文: 谢谢你，$N。这是你的神圣磨刀石，请谨慎使用。

english: Here you are, $N. Be careful out there. Our numbers are not so large we can afford many battlefield casualties.
old_奖励清单: 你将获得：特效治疗药水
new_译文: 给你，$N。外面小心些。我们人手不多，可经不起战场上再多伤亡。

english: Here you are, $N. Be careful out there. Our numbers are not so large we can afford many battlefield casualties.
old_奖励清单: 你将获得：特效法力药水
new_译文: 给你，$N。外面小心些。我们人手不多，可经不起战场上再多伤亡。

english: Take this tabard and wear it proudly. Perhaps your deeds might inspire others to take up arms in support of our fight against the Scourge.
old_奖励清单: 你将获得：银色黎明徽章
new_译文: 收下这面战袍，骄傲地穿着它。也许你的作为会激励更多人拿起武器，支援我们对抗天灾军团的战斗。

english: Ah, friendship - love for artistry - devotion to a higher being - and the promise to eternal dedication and faithfulness. Remarkable examples, really, you did splendidly! To be frank with you, I had almost forgotten about all of them, pardon my lack of decorum. This bow has a mind on his own and sometimes I don't even notice it shooting arrows on its own! Who knows, perhaps you will be its next target on your way out!$B$B<Kwee Q. chuckles at the thought.>$B$BHere, let me reward you for your efforts. Take this box, inside it are the finest garbments in all of Azeroth. Use their alluring charme and woo those cherished in your heart with them!
old_奖励清单: 你将获得：华丽装饰的容器
new_译文: 啊，友情——对艺术的热爱——对更高存在的虔诚——还有那永世奉献与忠诚的誓言。真是些了不起的范例，你做得太好了！老实说，我几乎把它们全都忘了，请原谅我的失礼。这把弓自有主见，有时连它自己射箭我都察觉不到！谁知道呢，说不定你出门的路上就成了它的下一个目标！$B$B<奎·Q一想到这儿就笑了。>$B$B喏，让我为你的辛劳给点奖赏。收下这箱子，里头是艾泽拉斯最精美的衣物。用它们的魅力去讨好你心里珍视的人吧！

english: <You assume what you are seeing is a smile on the Earthen's face. The rough gemstone from the giant's body looks tiny in his broad hands. A nod, that's all he offers, before telling you to kneel down once more.$B$BUpon placing his palm on you again, you see things a lot more clearly now, although the procedure is still taxing on you. Three gems manifest themselves before your inner eye. Luckily, you recognize them: an emberstone, a star ruby and a citrin. The next thing you see are the same gems getting cut into a facet you have never seen before. Watching intently, you memorize the movements. The wisdom is ingrained into your mind.>
old_奖励清单: 你将获得：设计图：尖锐黄水晶、设计图：明亮灰烬石、设计图：炽热红宝石
new_译文: <你猜想自己看到的是这位土灵脸上的笑容。巨人身上取下的粗糙宝石在他宽大的手掌里显得很小。他只点了点头，随后让你再次跪下。$B$B当他的手掌再次按上你时，你眼前的一切清晰了许多，尽管这过程依旧让你疲惫不堪。三颗宝石在你内视中显现。所幸你认得它们：一颗火烬石、一颗星红宝石和一颗黄水晶。接着你看到同样的宝石被切出一种你从未见过的刻面。你凝神细看，记住了每一个动作。这份智慧就此刻入你的心中。>

english: <The artisan inspects the faceted Lifeblood Gem. His amber eyes diligently observe every cut and edge of the sparkling red jewel. After finishing the evaluation, he hands you the gem back - before bowing down in respect.$B$BYou've passed the test! Thegren guides you to his table, eager to share his knowledge with his new pupil.>
old_奖励清单: 将对你施放以下法术：宝石学
new_译文: <这位匠人端详着那枚刻面过的活力宝石。他琥珀色的眼睛仔细审视着这颗闪亮红宝石的每一道切面与棱角。评定完毕后，他把宝石递还给你——随后躬身致意。$B$B你通过了考验！瑟格雷恩把你引到他的工作台前，迫不及待要把自己的知识传授给这位新学生。>

english: Mhm, mhm, not as shabby as I expected it to be. But it clearly bears Mayva's mark of shoddy craftsmanship. Good thing you are in my hands now, I'll whip you into a serviceable jewelcrafter in no time! Start by making this lovely trinket here, you should have no troubles replicating it… hopefully.
old_奖励清单: 你将获得：设计图：水晶耳环
new_译文: 嗯，嗯，没我想的那么糟。不过，这明显带着姆埃瓦那种粗糙手艺的印记。好在现在你落到我手里了，用不了多久，我就能把你调教成一个能用的珠宝匠！先做这件可爱的小饰品吧，照着做应该不难……但愿如此。

english: I don't know about you, but seeing these little treasures shine and sparkle under the light of my prospector's lens is something I'll never get tired of. Surely you understand. Now that we got that covered - here, listen close, I won't repeat myself!
old_奖励清单: 你将获得：设计图：闪亮青绿石戒指
new_译文: 我不知道你怎么想，但看着这些小宝贝在探矿镜的光下闪闪发亮，我是永远看不腻的。你一定能理解。既然说定了——来，听仔细，我可不说第二遍！

english: Bloodied, drenched, full of mud. Ugh, it breaks my heart to see one of my finer works in such a disrespectful state. Nevertheless, thank you for retrieving it. Tell me, where did you find it, on his beaten corpse or did someone else's grubby hands pilfered it from him? You know what? Don't tell me, I'd rather stay oblivious.$B$BAs compensation for your noble deed, I will teach you how to craft this choker yourself.
old_奖励清单: 你将获得：设计图：迷人的黄玉项链
new_译文: 血迹斑斑、湿漉漉、满是泥浆。唉，看到我一件得意之作被如此糟践，真让我心痛。不管怎么说，谢谢你把它取回来。告诉我，你是在他那被打烂的尸体上找到的，还是被别人的脏手顺走的？算了，别告诉我，我宁愿不知道。$B$B作为你这桩高尚之举的回报，我来教你亲手制作这条项圈。

english: Great work, I've seldom had that many ingredients for jewelcrafting at once in this place. I suppose some form of gratitude is needed towards Gulmire, since he has given me something practical to do whilst waiting for new reports.$B$BBack to you, however. Let me show you how to create these delicate trinkets.
old_奖励清单: 你将获得：设计图：水晶耳环
new_译文: 干得漂亮，我在这儿很少能一次拿到这么多珠宝加工材料。我想得向古尔米瑞道声谢，毕竟在等新情报的这段时间，他总算给了我一件实实在在的活儿。$B$B不过说回你。让我教你怎么做出这些精致的小饰品。

english: It may be faint, but there is power emanating from these gems. The best jewelcrafters are able to extract their mighty essences and amplify them to unprecedented heights. And if you'll allow me to say this: you are on a good way to reach that point yourself some day.
old_奖励清单: 你将获得：设计图：闪亮青绿石戒指
new_译文: 或许很微弱，但这些宝石里确实透出力量。最好的珠宝匠能从中提炼出强大的精髓，并将其增幅到前所未有的地步。若容我说一句：总有一天，你也会走到那一步。

english: Harrowing news. What you're describing is all too familiar - many former troll empires fell to their own hubris, thinking themselves above their people or even their loa. It is all the more relieving to see you return safe and sound.$B$BNow then, shall we pry the information from these tarnished pages?
old_奖励清单: 你将获得：设计图：迷人的黄玉项链
new_译文: 令人心惊的消息。你描述的这些，我听着太熟悉了——许多巨魔帝国都毁在自己的狂妄上，自以为高踞于族人或神灵之上。看到你安然归来，我就更放心了。$B$B那么，我们是不是该从这些残破的书页里挖出点线索了？

english: Impressive, such profound cuts and grinding work. Anyone can see the blood, sweat and tears you've poured into the creation of these. The life one breathes into their artworks is just as important as the technical steps taken. Jewelry without a soul is just a product and an affront to the integrity of the craft's millenia old legacy.$B$BBut you've proven that your heart beats in harmony with Azeroth, attuning yourself to its essence and channeling that energy into your art. As my new pupil, please allow me to pass my sacred knowledge unto you. You have earned it.$B$BOh, and should you ever see any of my former pupils again, tell them they can visit me anytime - I suppose some company can't hurt after a few years.
old_奖励清单: 将对你施放以下法术：大师级金匠学
new_译文: 了不起，如此深刻的切割与打磨。谁都看得出你为这些作品倾注了多少血汗与泪水。人赋予作品的生命，与技术步骤同样重要。没有灵魂的首饰只是一件商品，是对这门手艺千年传承的亵渎。$B$B而你已证明，你的心跳与艾泽拉斯同频——你与它的精魂共鸣，并把那份能量注入自己的艺术。作为我的新学生，请允许我把神圣的知识传授给你。这是你应得的。$B$B哦，若你以后遇见我从前哪个学生，告诉他们随时可以来看我——我想，隔了这些年，有个人做伴也无妨。

english: <The Artificer inspects your work and the replica.>$B$BClose. Without my guidance, you did an astounding job at repeating my pupil's steps. Remarkable. Nonetheless, to gauge your true potential, I expect you to craft an artpiece under my guidance. Here, listen close and show me that you listened well.
old_奖励清单: 你将获得：设计图：精致的金手镯
new_译文: <巧匠端详着你的成品与那件仿制品。>$B$B接近了。没有我的指点，你能把我的学生的步骤复现到这种程度，着实惊人。不过，要衡量你真正的潜力，我要你在我的指导下亲手做出一件作品。来，仔细听好，让我看看你听得够不够认真。

english: Perceiving the world as it is may appear simple and nothing out of the ordinary, but only those willing to delve deeper are able to gain a profound understanding of its true essence.$B$BYou've shown me you are one of them. Pay attention and heed my words, for they will bestow new insight to you.
old_奖励清单: 你将获得：设计图：深海之心
new_译文: 以本来面目观照世界，看似简单寻常，但唯有愿意深入其中的人，才能真正洞悉其本质。$B$B你已向我证明你是这样的人。用心听我说的话，它们会给你新的领悟。

english: <The Artificer is surprisingly solemn at the view of your pieces. A soft chuckle escapes him, before turning back to you.>$B$BThank you. I am glad you sought me out. Here, I will share with you something Gallitrea designed during my tutelage.
old_奖励清单: 你将获得：设计图：加莉特蕾娅之法杖
new_译文: <看到你带来的物件，巧匠出奇地郑重。他轻声一笑，才重新看向你。>$B$B谢谢你。我很高兴你来找我。来，我把加莉特蕾娅在我门下时设计的一件东西送给你。

english: Tragic and harrowing to hear. Both the intervention of draenei from our homeworld, and Kum'isha's desperate desire to return to said place. I have led my people to this place in search of a haven, a sanctuary they can someday call home again. With the wisdom on this scroll and the magic of the Draenethyst, we may achieve this - together.$B$BBe rest assured, your deeds for my people will not be forgotten. Let me share insight on these scriptures, as you cannot read its pages yourself.
old_奖励清单: 你将获得：设计图：德莱尼水晶魔棒
new_译文: 听来悲惨又骇人——无论是来自我们母星的德莱尼人的干预，还是库米沙一心想要回到故土的执念。我带着族人来到此地，是为了寻找一处避风港，一处终有一天能再度称之为家的庇护所。有了这卷轴上的智慧与德莱尼水晶的魔法，我们或许能实现它——一起。$B$B请放心，你为我族人所做的一切不会被遗忘。既然你读不懂这经卷，就让我为你讲讲其中的奥义吧。

english: <Talvash opens the bag and looks exasperated.>$B$BWhat?! This is only half of what I was promised! Oh, this damn cutthroat, sleezy slimebag, and damn his very threatening bodyguards too! Well, atleast I am not dead, correct? I have to thank you for that - really, I am grateful! You stuck out your neck for me without even hesitating, that's something not so common nowadays. Hopefully these thugs will not care to bother me again.$B$BBut do tell me: the jewelry you delivered in my stead, are you a jewelcrafter by chance? If so, please let me share one of my patented designs with you for your valiant heroism!
old_奖励清单: 你将获得：设计图：精致秘银护符
new_译文: <塔瓦斯德打开袋子，一脸恼火。>$B$B什么？！这才是我被答应的一半！哦，这个该死的刽子手、卑鄙的滑头，连他那帮凶神恶煞的保镖也一起见鬼去吧！不过，至少我还活着，对吧？这得谢谢你——说真的，我很感激！你毫不犹豫地为我冒险，如今这种事可不多见。但愿这帮恶棍不会再来找我麻烦。$B$B不过请告诉我：你替我送去的那件首饰，你莫非是珠宝匠？若是，请允许我把一份专利设计分享给你，作为你这份英勇的酬谢！

english: Oh, wow! This thing is almost as big as my nose! Those adventurers weren't lying, that's for sure. And the necklace you brought, incredibly fine work, truly impressive. You got a nick for jewelcrafting, just like I told you. Really, you helped me out immensely. Those hot-shots in Booty Bay are going to drool over this beauty, just you wait! As thanks for all your hard work and assistance, let me share one of my personal favourite designs with you.
old_奖励清单: 你将获得：设计图：精致秘银护符
new_译文: 哦，哇！这东西几乎跟我的鼻子一样大！那些冒险者果然没吹牛。还有你带来的项链，做工精细得惊人，真了不起。我说过吧，你在珠宝加工上有天分。真的，你帮了我大忙。藏宝海湾那些自以为了不起的家伙，看到这宝贝准会流口水，你等着瞧！为答谢你这一路的辛苦与帮助，我把一份我个人最中意的设计分享给你。

english: Oho, now that's the stuff. I can tell right away that we can salvage that mess of Traxis with this miracle mixture. Did you come along with Zalashji? He's a solitary... man? Snake? I don't know, but so far he didn't say no to a long and philosophical talk about the history and art of jewelcrafting. Who knows, maybe someday I will tell you how we two met!$B$BSince you helped me with preventing uncomfortable customer confrontations, let me reward you. Am I correct in assuming you're proficient in jewelcrafting as well? Don't be surprised, I'm not a master in this craft for nothing. Let me share some of my knowledge for free, as just payment.
old_奖励清单: 你将获得：设计图：华丽秘银手镯
new_译文: 嚯，这才是好东西。我一眼就看出，用这神奇的混合物能把特拉希斯那摊烂摊子救回来。你是跟萨拉辛一起来的？他是个独来独往的……男人？还是蛇？我不清楚，不过到目前为止，他倒没拒绝过跟我长谈珠宝加工的历史与艺术。谁知道呢，说不定哪天我会跟你讲讲我俩是怎么认识的！$B$B既然你帮我避免了一场尴尬的顾客冲突，那就让我给你点回报。我猜你珠宝加工也不差，对吧？别惊讶，我毕竟是这行的大师。就让我免费分享些心得，权当报酬。

english: The gemstone was split? Curious, but not unexpected given the tower's state. Still, having it hidden like that - what was Medivh thinking? And this focus... a testament to the dragonflight's eternal charge of governing magic. I doubt any living mortal could conjure such a device to amplify the flow of energy.$B$BIt is bittersweet, you know? I've abjured my life as a sorcerer, yet I cannot deny helping you for the second time now lights up a feeling in my heart long forgotten. My hopes of you putting the horrors of the tower to rest grow after witnessing you succeed in this task. Take the completed head, and search the tower for the rest of it. Most assuredly, this will prove to be pivotal in your exploration of Karazhan.
old_奖励清单: 你将获得：麦迪文的权杖头
new_译文: 宝石被劈开了？有意思，不过以那座塔的状况倒也不意外。可把它那样藏起来——麦迪文到底在想什么？还有这个聚焦器……足以证明龙族对掌管魔法一事确有其永恒的职责。我不觉得活着的凡人能造出这种增幅能量流动的装置。$B$B说来苦乐参半，你懂吗？我早已宣誓放弃术士的身份，却无法否认：这第二次帮你，让我心中一种久违的感觉重新亮了起来。看着你完成这件事，我对你能让塔中恐怖安息这件事更有信心了。带上这枚修复好的杖头，再去塔里搜寻剩下的部分。毫无疑问，这会在你探索卡拉赞时起到关键作用。

english: Positively outstanding. What we've witnessed proved my suspicions correct: the ley line crystals function as a conduit of energy that, when exposed to concentrated amounts of magic, manifest themselves in arcane monstrosities. If you take a closer look, both crystal remains are identical, meaning the blood elves have altered their own crystal after obtaining it from the Blue Dragonflight - whether they got it by force or cooperation, I am unsure to answer.$B$BThanks to you, my understanding of this land and its inhabitants heightened again. It is concerning, however, to know the Blue Dragonflight is undertaking such suspicious actions. They rarely care for the affairs of mortals, but do not hesitate to halt the abuse of Azeroth's magic in an instant. Let us observe and hope for the best outcome for now.$B$BAs for your reward; you are a capable jewelcrafter, correct? Let me show you how to fashion a staff that amplifies the wielder's magical abilities, then.
old_奖励清单: 你将获得：设计图：皇家曙光权杖
new_译文: 简直出色极了。我们所见印证了我的猜想：魔网水晶是一种能量导管，一旦暴露在高度浓缩的魔法下，便会显现为奥术魔物。你若细看，两块水晶残骸完全相同——这意味着血精灵从蓝龙军团那里取得水晶后，改造了自己的那一块；究竟是用强夺还是合作，我也说不准。$B$B多亏你，我对这片土地及其居民的了解又深了一层。不过，得知蓝龙军团正在做这种可疑的事，仍令人不安。他们很少在意凡人的事务，却会毫不犹豫地阻止对艾泽拉斯魔法的滥用。眼下我们只能观察，并期盼最好的结果。$B$B至于你的奖励：你也是个能干的珠宝匠，对吧？那就让我教你怎么做出一把能增幅持有者魔法能力的法杖。

english: You got the stuff? Great, now then, how about we test this theory of ours?$B$B<Fanzy opens the page of the book and holds it high above her head. When brought near the empty page, the cores and essences liquify and transfer themselves to the parchment - ultimately forming sentences, completing the instruction for this piece of jewelry.>$B$BWOW! Now that was absolutely amazing. Scrap what I said about this book, this is pretty nifty, I have to admit. Incredible, come here, let us scour this page together, we wouldn't have come this far without your dedication!
old_奖励清单: 你将获得：设计图：精致钻石宝冠
new_译文: 东西都拿到了？太好了，那我们来验证一下这个猜想如何？$B$B<凡兹翻开书页，把它高高举过头顶。当它靠近空白页时，那些核心与精华开始液化，转移到羊皮纸上——最终凝结成文字，补全了这件首饰的制作说明。>$B$B哇！这真是绝了！我之前说的那些关于这本书的话收回，不得不承认，这玩意真带劲。太不可思议了，过来，我们一起把这一页研究透——没有你的投入，我们走不到这一步！

english: Excellent work. Just getting your hands on one of these gems is a feat in itself, I can't imagine how much effort you poured into getting three! Okay, hand all the things over, I'm in the mood to create a MASTERPIECE!$B$B<Fanzy snatches the materials and hastily moves her tiny hands. After a few minutes, she holds the delicate lens into the sunlight, directly in front of the empty page. Surprisingly, instead of burning it, the focused beam of light creates elaborate sentences on the formerly clear paper.>$B$BEUREKA! A complete success! Time to harvest the fruits of our labor! Come here, let's read together!
old_奖励清单: 你将获得：设计图：精制钻石手镯
new_译文: 干得漂亮。光是弄到一颗这样的宝石已算了得，我简直无法想象你为拿到三颗费了多少功夫！好，都交给我吧，我正想创作一件杰作！$B$B<凡兹夺过材料，小手飞快地动起来。几分钟后，她把那枚精巧的镜片举到阳光下，正对着空白页。令人意外的是，聚焦的光束非但没有烧焦纸面，反而在原本空白的纸上浮现出繁复的文字。>$B$B我找到了！大获成功！是时候收获我们的成果了！过来，我们一起读读看！

english: I am devastated. Not even in the wildest of dreams could I have imagined this to happen. Sanv Tas'dal, once my mentor as chieftain and noble leader of our tribe, succumbing to the sweet lies of the Burning Legion. If it wasn't for you and Akh Z'ador, then my people and I would have followed him back to Draenor, to live the rest of our lives as drones for the Legion's machinations.$B$BThe Harborage is forever in your debt. Words cannot express how heavy my gratitude towards your selflessness lies, so please: Take this symbol of appreciation from all draenei of this humble sanctuary.
old_奖励清单: 你可以从这些奖励中选择其一：裂隙行者的法衣、虚空碎片指环、避难所守卫肩铠、德莱尼水坠饰
new_译文: 我悲痛欲绝。即便在最荒诞的梦里，我也想不到会如此。桑夫·塔斯达尔，曾是我们的酋长、我的导师，也是我族高贵的领袖，竟屈从于燃烧军团的甜言蜜语。若不是你和阿克资阿多，我和族人便会随他回到德拉诺，余生都做军团阴谋的傀儡。$B$B避难所永远欠你一份人情。言语无法表达我对你这份无私的感激有多沉重。所以，请收下这份心意——它来自这座小小圣所里所有德莱尼人。
note: Sanv Tas'dal 库内无词条，试译「桑夫·塔斯达尔」

english: $N, I thank you from the bottom of my heart for all you have done for the Harborage. Kas'tal managed to contact me just in time. Any later and I fear for what might've happened. Now, to what I wanted to talk with you about…$B$B<Akh Z'ador presents a flawlessly round and shimmering teal crystal to you unlike anything you've seen before.>$B$BWhat you see here is a pure draenethyst gemstone, one of the most rare commodities my people valued back on Draenor. Its status is akin to myth, although they are not the fairytale one might assume. Althoug it is just a theory, I assume this one was created between the clash of Tas'dal's and my own rift magic. I want you to have it, as thanks - but also as a promise. The draenei of the Harborage will aid you if needed, for without you, we'd be no more. Enkil Toralar, friend, and may the winds of the Twisting Nether be in your favor.
old_奖励清单: 你将获得：纯净德莱尼水宝石
new_译文: $N，我由衷感谢你为避难所做的一切。卡斯塔尔及时联系上了我。再晚一步，后果不堪设想。那么，说说我想跟你说的事……$B$B<阿克资阿多向你呈上一颗浑圆无瑕、泛着青绿光泽的水晶，是你从未见过的东西。>$B$B你眼前这颗是纯净的德莱尼水晶宝石，是我族在德拉诺时最珍视的稀有之物之一。它的地位近乎传说，当然并非童话里那种。虽然只是推测，但我猜这一颗诞生于塔斯达尔的裂隙魔法与我的相撞之时。我想把它给你，作为答谢——也作为一个承诺。只要你有需要，避难所的德莱尼人都会相助，因为没有你，我们早已不复存在。恩基尔·托拉拉尔，朋友，愿扭曲虚空的风眷顾你。
note: Kas'tal 试译「卡斯塔尔」；Enkil Toralar 为德莱尼告别语，音译保留

english: An exhausting process, but here it is; another pure gemstone. Please, take good care of it.
old_奖励清单: 你将获得：纯净德莱尼水宝石
new_译文: 过程很累人，但总算成了：又一颗纯净的宝石。请好好保管它。

english: Back in Eldre'thalas, we studied countless, now long forgotten runes in our arcane sanctums under the order of Queen Azshara. Many of these I have forgotten over time, while others out of shame. Nonetheless, it seems my knowledge from that bygone era allowed us to gain new wisdom - wisdom you may use at your own discretion. Here, listen closely. It is time for a new lesson, pupil.
old_奖励清单: 你将获得：设计图：黄金符文戒指
new_译文: 当年在埃达拉斯，我们奉艾萨拉女王之命，在奥术圣殿里研究过无数如今早已被遗忘的符文。其中许多我已随时间淡忘，还有一些则因羞愧而不愿想起。不过看来，那段旧日学识让我们获得了新的智慧——这份智慧你可以自行斟酌使用。来，仔细听好。该上新课了，学生。

english: It is finished. The fear weighing heavy on my heart is fading after hearing from your valiant deeds. Using my ability to gaze into the Emerald Dream, I will return this fragment back to my grandfather. Simply holding it makes me feel his radiant and powerful aura once more.$B$BIt will take a considerable amount of time for him to regain his full strength, however Ysera and his fellow Wild Gods are at his side, protecting their beloved friend and mentor.$B$BYour devotion to the White Stag and his legacy is commendable. To honor your heroic and selfless nature, let me offer you the teachings to shift into Malorne's stag form itself.
old_奖励清单: 你将获得：白色雄鹿之雕文
new_译文: 结束了。听闻你那些英勇事迹，压在我心头的恐惧正在消散。我会用窥视翡翠梦境的能力，把这块碎片送回我祖父身边。光是握着它，我就又能感到他那光辉而强大的气息。$B$B他要完全恢复力量还需要相当长的时间，不过伊瑟拉和他的荒野之神同伴们都在他身旁，守护着这位亲爱的朋友与导师。$B$B你对白鹿及其传承的忠诚值得称道。为褒奖你这无私的英雄之举，就让我把变化为玛洛恩雄鹿形态的诀窍传授给你。

english: Big candle for Big Whiskers! My mission in this scary place is finished. Big Whiskers gives you this as thanks. Very fun book, look!
old_奖励清单: 你将获得：变形术之秘典：啮齿动物
new_译文: 大蜡烛给大胡须！我在这鬼地方的活儿干完了。大胡须把这个送给你，当作谢礼。很好玩的书，你看！
note: NPC 61990 现名「大小老鼠」（机翻），本句按「大胡须」译；建议后续把该 NPC 改名

english: The chest opens and a wet odor escapes it. Inside you find some rusted trinkets - and a surprisingly immaculate piece of something broken. Picking it up, you feel a sense of danger coming from it. Harrowing.
old_奖励清单: 你将获得：古老神像下碎片
new_译文: 箱子打开，一股潮湿的气味涌了出来。里面是一些锈迹斑斑的小玩意——还有一件碎裂之物，竟出奇地完好。你把它拿起来，感到一股危险的气息自其中透出。令人心惊。

english: <Tillia is speechless at the task you accomplished. Marveling at her long lost treasure, she regains her composure and begins speaking.>$B$BIncredible, positively stunning! You are a masterful detective, getting to the bottom of this decade-old conundrum in such a short time. Were I back at my estate, I would have my brother knight you into our personal entourage. But alas, I believe the thrill of the world is what beckons you, while my undeath binds me to this place. Fret not, however - with my necklace returned, I can endure this endless limbo in contempt.$B$BAs promised, you shall receive this in turn: a prized ruby ring by the lord of the tower himself, Guardian Medivh.
old_奖励清单: 你将获得：镶宝的红宝石指环
new_译文: <蒂莉亚为你完成的任务震惊得说不出话。她端详着失而复得的珍宝，慢慢镇定下来，开口道。>$B$B太不可思议了，简直令人惊叹！你是个了不起的侦探，这么快就查清了这桩十年前的悬案。若我还在自己的庄园，我会让我的兄弟为你授勋、纳入我们的随从。可惜啊，我想这世界的精彩才是你的召唤，而我这不死的躯体却把我困在此地。不过别担心——项链回到我手里，我便能带着轻蔑忍受这无尽的囚笼。$B$B如约，这份东西归你：一枚珍贵红宝石戒指，出自这座塔的主人、守护者麦迪文之手。

english: I dread the day I will have to fight one I called friend. Alas.$B$BKel'theril like many other Highborne settlements was filled with magic. Magic that was lost to the ages – I am the last survivor of these lands that have yet to flee it. I have had these draconic artifacts ever since the lake swallowed my home. Take one, it is yours now. Something to remind you of me. Until we meet again.
old_奖励清单: 你可以从这些奖励中选择其一：织法者之爪击、极寒冰霜之魔棒、地脉流之碎片
new_译文: 我一直害怕有一天要与自己称作朋友的人为敌。唉。$B$B凯斯利尔和许多上层精灵聚居地一样，曾充盈着魔法——那些魔法已随岁月湮没，而我是这片土地上尚未逃离的最后一位幸存者。自从湖水吞没我的家，这些龙族器物就一直在我手里。挑一件吧，它归你了。留个念想，记得我。后会有期。

english: I appreciate the effort, $N. This was definitely not an easy task, yet you provided me with such quality materials in no time at all.$B$BGemstones like the Blood of the Mountain require an extraordinary amount of precision and patience. Just the tiniest bit of unnecessary pressure and the entire jewel cracks in two. Watch closely, for I have only one chance to teach you. You can keep the gemstone once I'm done. See it as thanks for bringing me such a peculiar example of a gem.
old_奖励清单: 你将获得：华丽山地宝石、设计图：华丽山地宝石
new_译文: 我很感激你的付出，$N。这绝不是轻松的差事，你却这么快就给我弄来了这么高品质的材料。$B$B像山脉之血这样的宝石，需要极高的精准与耐心。只要多施加一丝不该有的力道，整颗宝石就会裂成两半。仔细看着，我只有一次机会教你。做完之后这颗宝石就归你——就当是谢你给我带来这么一件稀奇的样品。

english: Intriguing. These samples radiate a magic not unfamiliar to me, on first glance I'd even say they emanate druidic magic. Ofcourse, I shouldn't jump to conclusions. Further research within the Cenarion Circle will be needed. Surely their venerable druids can solve the origin of their volatile growth.$B$B$N, you have my appreciation. Please, take one of these as compensation for your troubles.
old_奖励清单: 你可以从这些奖励中选择其一：法力药水、强效治疗药水
new_译文: 有意思。这些样本散发的魔法我并不陌生，乍看之下，我甚至要说它们透着德鲁伊的法术。当然，我不该急着下结论。还需要在塞纳里奥议会做进一步研究——他们那些可敬的德鲁伊想必能弄清它们狂暴生长的根源。$B$B$N，我很感激你。请收下一件，作为你辛苦的补偿。

english: I hope his soul may find its peace in the Light once more.
old_奖励清单: 你将获得：救赎之搜寻项链
new_译文: 愿他的灵魂能在圣光中重归安宁。

english: The darkness of the nightmare loomed over my on thoughts, breaking free emotions that I would usually keep in check. In a way, I regret it has come to this.$B$B<Nalpak sets Zandara's head on the ground.>$B$BA job well done, is a job well rewarded. You have my thanks $N.
old_奖励清单: 你将获得：科卡尔披风
new_译文: 噩梦的黑暗曾笼罩我的思绪，把我一向压住的情绪都逼了出来。某种程度上，我也后悔事情走到这一步。$B$B<纳尔帕克把赞妲拉的头颅放在地上。>$B$B活干得好，就该有好报。谢谢你，$N。

english: Precious, these notes are. Very precious. I doubt it'd cripple the Scarlets from making more lightforge armor at this point, but at least it's back in my hands.
old_奖励清单: 你可以从这些奖励中选择其一：坚固的磨刀石、坚固的平衡石
new_译文: 这些笔记很珍贵，非常珍贵。我不觉得这时候就能让血色十字军造不出光铸护甲，但至少它回到了我手里。

english: Terrifying. Even if these are only remains from a volatile elemental, the sheer pressure coming from it is overwhelming. With this fount of energy, I will be able to combine the rod and the binding together, recreating the Scepter Rod of Medivh. Though now restored, it is still incomplete. The scepter head is missing; where to find it, however, is beyond my knowledge. Shall it fall in your possession, speak to me again, and I will do my best to aid you again.
old_奖励清单: 你将获得：麦迪文之节杖魔棒
new_译文: 太骇人了。即便只是某个狂暴元素残留的遗物，它散发出的压迫感依然令人窒息。有了这份能量源泉，我就能把法杖与束具合而为一，重现麦迪文之杖。不过它虽已复原，却仍不完整——杖头丢失了。至于去哪里找，我就无从知晓了。若它落到你手里，再来找我，我会尽力再帮你一次。

english: I entrust you with the Scepter of Medivh, conduit of ley magic and the primal energies of an alien world. With it you may command the violent magical torrents of Karazhan itself. Don't get complacent; while you are certainly powerful, the scepter' former owner is the only person to properly wield it. Nevertheless, the deepest secrets of the accursed tower now lay at your feet, begging to be unveiled by the one strong-minded enough to brave its treacherous reaches.$B$BGo forth and claim the truth you fought so valiantly for! Let the conquest of Karazhan be one of the milestones of your heroic legacy!
old_奖励清单: 你将获得：麦迪文之节杖
new_译文: 我把麦迪文之杖托付给你——它是魔网魔法的导管，也是异界原初能量的容器。凭它，你可以号令卡拉赞本身狂暴的魔法洪流。别因此自满；你固然强大，但真正能驾驭这法杖的，唯有它从前的主人。尽管如此，这座被诅咒之塔最深处的秘密如今已伏在你脚下，只等着那位意志足够坚定、敢于闯过险途之人前来揭开。$B$B去吧，去取回你如此英勇奋战所追寻的真相！让征服卡拉赞成为你英雄传奇中的一座里程碑！

english: A crumbled piece of paper. It's sad to see it reduced to this, no matter what. I will restore it for you, as holding it made me remember it.
old_奖励清单: 你将获得：配方：强能草药沙拉
new_译文: 一张皱巴巴的纸。不管怎么说，看到它变成这样都让人难过。我替你把它复原——把它拿在手里，让我想起了它原来的样子。

english: And there we have it, with the glyph complete it can now be used. As to whether you choose to or not, remains up to you.
old_奖励清单: 你将获得：奥术树人之雕文
new_译文: 好了，符文既已补全，现在就能用了。至于你愿不愿意用，那就随你。

english: The master is an enigmatic man, and I will most likely never fully understand the ways of his mind. Luckily that's not what we are here for, right?$B$BThis pearl you brought, truly something else. Every student of the master's receives a personal gift from him - and technically me - as proof of their accomplishments. Mine is the stinger of a scorpid I've slain in the Thousand Needles. And for you... what do you think of a pendant?
old_奖励清单: 你将获得：决心之证词
new_译文: 大师是个难以捉摸的人，我大概永远也弄不懂他的心思。好在我们要的不是这个，对吧？$B$B你带来的这颗珍珠，真是不同寻常。大师的每个学生都会从他——严格说也包括我——那里得到一件私人礼物，作为成就的凭证。我的是我在千针石林杀掉的一只蝎子的尾刺。至于你……你觉得一枚坠饰如何？

english: By the mines of Kezan! This smells horrible. One whiff of it and any grown sailor will fall over in a heartbeat. $N, excellent job. While we were able to secure this end of the operations, we still have to investigate where exactly they're getting all the supplies from, as I am sure the Venture Co. is simply a middle man. Still, so far you did great and for that I've got a reward for you. Stay clear of trouble, adventurer, wouldn't want to see you getting killed.
old_奖励清单: 你可以从这些奖励中选择其一：特工披风、正直之护腕
new_译文: 以科赞的矿脉起誓！这味道太呛人了。随便谁闻上一口，壮实的船员也得当场倒地。$N，干得漂亮。虽然我们保住了这一头的作业，但还得查清他们到底从哪儿弄来这些补给——我敢肯定，风险投资公司不过是个中间人。总之，到目前为止你做得很好，我为你备了份奖励。别招惹麻烦，冒险者，我可不想看到你送命。

english: These will do just fine. Alongside these potent mushrooms, I can create an exceptionally powerful dreamveil for you. Without it I fear you may be pulled into the Dream prematurely, without ever being able to return. Now brace yourself, $N. For you to be granted Dreamsight, you will be seeking an audience with one of the oldest green dragons known to Azeroth.
old_奖励清单: 你将获得：沉眠梦幕
new_译文: 这些就够了。有了这些效力强劲的蘑菇，我能为你调制一剂格外强力的梦境帷幕。没有它，我怕你会过早被拉入梦境，再也回不来。现在打起精神，$N。要获得梦境之视，你得去觐见艾泽拉斯最古老的绿龙之一。

english: I see. As solemn as it is, Vithekus' disdain is understandable. An ancient being like himself can all so easily be swayed from his benevolence after witnessing the misdeeds of mortals throughout the eons. Still I had hoped he would continue to see the potential your people hold.$B$BNevertheless, knowing he can be reasoned with and did not fall victim to the Nightmare lifts a burdening worry from my heart.
old_奖励清单: 你将获得：梦见宝石
new_译文: 我明白了。尽管听着令人沉重，维瑟库斯的轻蔑也可以理解。像他这样的古老存在，在目睹凡人千万年来的种种劣行之后，善意很容易动摇。我仍希望他能继续看到你们这些族人所蕴藏的潜力。$B$B不过，知道他可以沟通、也没有沦为噩梦的牺牲品，总算让我心里一块石头落了地。

english: <Tranquility sets upon the Twilight Grove. The Nightmare has been fended off once more, but for how long, no one can tell. Your heart tells you the battle for the Emerald Dream is not yet over, yet you find solace in knowing its stalwart defenders will continue the righteous battle. In front of you towers arguably nature's greatest force. The teal fur, glistening like a starlit sky; his eyes reflecting a deep blue sea of infinite wisdom. You expect the force of his power to crush you, but instead that all so familiar warmth, like a sunny breeze gliding over dew laden grass in the morning, washes over you.$B$BTurning your eyes upwards, your gaze meets the demigod's and a feeling of power rushes through your body. An incomparable sensation; of growth, appreciation and love. As quickly as it came, so did it vanish. Feeling reborn, you pay your respects to the Waywatcher before leaving him to his duties.>
old_奖励清单: 将对你施放以下法术：迅捷旅行形态
