english: Simply marvelous. A job well done. Thronda should listen well and follow your example. She has great potential, but her lack of discipline is a dire thorn in my side - and hers, too. Still, I can only partially blame her, for it is my sworn duty to her parents to foster her magical talent as much as her growth as a person.$B$BYou have my deepest gratitude, good traveler. Before you go, take one of these as compensation for the troubles. Be sure to step wary during these trying times.
old_奖励清单: 你可以从这些奖励中选择其一：玛姬露的塔罗图鉴、兜帽退学者便鞋
new_译文: 真是妙极了。干得漂亮。斯尔奥恩达该好好听着，以你为榜样。她天赋极高，可缺乏纪律这一点，既是我心头的大刺，也是她的。不过，我也只能怪她一半——毕竟我曾向她父母立誓，既要培育她的魔法天赋，也要助她成长为人。$B$B好旅人，我由衷感谢你。走之前，收下一件作为补偿。眼下时局多艰，务必步步留心。

english: Is it done? Is this the head of their mongrel leader? Good riddance to them, their lot has chosen what path to tread - a path leading to their timely demise. I appreciate your courage, adventurer. Here, take this as reward for the good deed. With your actions, we may soon live our solemn lives yet again.
old_奖励清单: 你将获得：伐木工外衣
new_译文: 办妥了？这就是他们那个杂种首领的首级？他们死得好，那帮家伙既已选了自己的路——一条通向灭亡的路。冒险者，我欣赏你的胆量。来，收下这份奖赏。有你这样的作为，我们或许很快就能重归安稳的日子。

english: Wonderful, their delighted expressions cast a smile on my own face everytime I see them. These children are the future of the Alliance, and it is our responsibility to prepare them for their own decisions as best as we possibly can. I will make sure the Church knows about your contributions today, good deeds will not go unnoticed. Did you learn something yourself, by chance? The island of Balor is a divisive topic within the kingdom, many of the superstitious dare not mention its name still. Regardless, it is part of our past and as such should be remembered.
old_奖励清单: 你将获得：训斥之杖
new_译文: 太好了，每次看到他们欢喜的神情，我自己也会笑出来。这些孩子是联盟的未来，而我们责任所在，就是尽力让他们为自己的人生抉择做好准备。我会确保教会知晓你今日的贡献——善行不会被忽视。你自己可有学到什么吗？巴罗岛在王国里是个争议不断的话题，许多迷信的人至今不敢提起它的名字。但无论如何，它都是我们过去的一部分，理应被记住。

english: <The witch is cackling in an uncomfortable manner.>$B$BUseful after all. Here, some homebrewed potions of mine, just for you. You may stay a while and ask me anything. The woods have knowledge most don't dare to ask...
old_奖励清单: 你可以从这些奖励中选择其一：侦测次级隐形药剂、次级隐形药水、抗魔药水
new_译文: <女巫以一种令人不适的方式咯咯笑着。>$B$B到底还是派上了用场。喏，我自酿的几瓶药水，专门给你的。你可以在这儿待一会儿，想问什么就问。这片林子知道的事，多数人是不敢问的……

english: There it is! I cannot thank you enough, truly! Had I lost these, I wouldn't know if I'd be able to bear it. Everything in here are memories of the good friends I made during my time as a mountaineer, ones that visited me and my mountain rest whenever their duty took a toll on their bodies. For their sake, we have to reclaim it as soon as possible.
old_奖励清单: 你可以从这些奖励中选择其一：巡山人破裂、灰烬之拳长靴、雪天使法杖
new_译文: 就是它！我真不知道该怎么谢你！要是把这些弄丢了，我怕自己根本承受不住。这里头全是我当巡山人时结识的好友留下的念想——每当公务把他们累垮，他们就会来山里看我、歇歇脚。为了他们，我们得尽快把这里夺回来。

english: <Operative Hawthorne lets out a deep sigh hearing your findings. Looking clearly exhausted, he begins rubbing his eyes as a sign of defeat.>$B$BThis whole ordeal proves to be more of a conundrum than I had hoped it would be. All three suspects act unrelated to our case, setting us back to zero. As much as it dismays me, I have to start my investigation anew. I will revoke your deputization; what you've done for me saved me valuable time, but I cannot demand any more of you. If I am fortunate enough, then the SI:7 will send someone to support me here. Until then, I must focus on my work. Farewell, $N.
old_奖励清单: 你可以从这些奖励中选择其一：黑石锋利的切肉刀、灰木弓
new_译文: <特工霍桑听完你的发现，长长地叹了口气。他显然疲惫不堪，开始揉眼睛，像是认了输。>$B$B这一整桩事到头来比我希望的还要难解。三名嫌犯的行为都与本案无关，我们又回到了原点。尽管沮丧，我还是得重新开始调查。我会撤销你的副手委任；你为我做的已经省下我宝贵的时间，我不能再多要求你什么。若我运气够好，军情七处会派人来支援我。在那之前，我必须专心办案了。再会，$N。

english: You have come to claim your bounty have you?$B$B<Commander Aggnash lets out a hearty laugh.>$B$BYour actions this day may have saved lives within Shatterblade and for that you have my thanks. Your actions are worthy of the Horde, and even more worthy of reward.
old_奖励清单: 你可以从这些奖励中选择其一：裂刃护手、远征队长靴
new_译文: 你是来领赏金的吧？$B$B<阿格娜什指挥官爽朗地大笑。>$B$B你今日的作为或许让裂刃的许多人保住了性命，为此我得谢你。你的行动无愧于部落，更无愧于这份奖赏。

english: <Commander Aggnash looks on with a slight gaze of disbelief>$B$BYou were successful?$B$B<Commander Aggnash lets out a hearty laugh>$B$BYou have overcome your enemy, you have defeated Korlag! A mighty foe such as him was a dauntless task, and yet here you are, victorious. Be proud in your glory today, for you have done what very few could achieve.$B$BTake this, as a thanks from the Horde itself!
old_奖励清单: 你可以从这些奖励中选择其一：厄运之歌护腕、扎姆格斯之腰带、格斯卡尔的护腿
new_译文: <阿格娜什指挥官带着几分难以置信看着你。>$B$B你成功了？$B$B<阿格娜什指挥官爽朗地大笑起来。>$B$B你战胜了敌人，击败了科尔拉格！像他这样的强敌本是无畏的难题，可你偏偏站在这里，凯旋而归。今日你该为自己的荣耀而骄傲，因为你做到了极少有人能做到的事。$B$B收下这个，这是部落本身的谢意！

english: Glory and honor to your name! You have defeated our foe, and brought victory to the Horde. I have prepared a few items, take one and let it help on your journey.
old_奖励清单: 你可以从这些奖励中选择其一：黑铁青铜之锤、格罗尔丹的披风
new_译文: 荣耀与光荣归于你的名字！你击败了我们的敌人，为部落带来了胜利。我备了几件东西，挑一件，让它陪你走完接下来的路。

english: I hope the poor merchant was simply robbed and not beaten for blood—or worse. Alas, you have done your part, and for that, I am more than thankful. There is little I can offer, but take this. It was the last painting I did.
old_奖励清单: 你将获得：树叶之决斗
new_译文: 我希望那位可怜的商人只是被抢了财物，而不是被打得流血——或者更糟。总之，你尽到了自己的本分，对此我不胜感激。我拿不出什么，就收下这幅画吧。那是我画的最后一幅。

english: Duke Sherwood is a close friend; many times he has denied the use of servants. It warms my heart to think he would find one in you. My armory is humble, and these are trying times—at most, for your service, I can reward you with this.
old_奖励清单: 你可以从这些奖励中选择其一：叶卫、琥珀木巨斧
new_译文: 谢尔伍德公爵是我的挚友，他多次拒绝使用仆人。想到他会在你身上破例，我就觉得欣慰。我的武备库很简陋，眼下又是艰难时世——为你的辛劳，我最多只能以此相赠。

english: Ah, there you are! Thank you, thank you. I believe they were going to dismantle my stall if you hadn't shown up when you did. As promised—a free pack of Amberglaze Donuts and an extra coin as a tip.
old_奖励清单: 你将获得：琥珀釉甜甜圈
new_译文: 啊，你来了！谢谢，谢谢你。要不是你及时赶到，他们怕是要把我的摊子给拆了。按约定——一包免费的琥珀釉甜甜圈，外加一枚小费。

english: Hey $N, is she still looking at me? Bah, that woman makes me so uncomfortable. Anyway, did you manage to get the horseshoes? Oh, thank the Light. Here, take this and be quick about it. And, just in case, don't show up during the tournament.
old_奖励清单: 你将获得：激流堡卫之魔棒
new_译文: 喂，$N，她还在盯着我看吗？唉，那女人让我浑身不自在。对了，马蹄铁拿到了吗？哦，感谢圣光。喏，拿着这个，动作快点。还有——以防万一，比赛期间别露面。

english: Hand them over; everything is ready. You may take an apple yourself for helping me out.
old_奖励清单: 你将获得：新鲜的红苹果
new_译文: 都交给我吧，一切就绪。你帮了我，可以自己拿一个苹果。

english: Grandmother sent you, and she said that? Oh, I miss her dearly. I can't wait to try everything she sent me. I hear the donuts are very famous in Northwind. And I will treasure this toy from Mother forever. Thank you, adventurer. You have done me a great favor, and as Prince of Stormwind, I would reward you with something from our armory—if I could. Instead, I will give you this book I have from the Archbishop.$B$BDo come and tell me of your adventures sometimes; this palace is dull and boring. I could use a friend.
old_奖励清单: 你将获得：祈祷之记录图鉴
new_译文: 是奶奶派你来的？她还说了那些话？哦，我真想她。她寄来的东西我迫不及待要一一尝遍。听说北风的甜甜圈很有名气。而母亲给我的这个玩具，我会永远珍藏。谢谢你，冒险者。你帮了我一个大忙；作为暴风城的王子，我本该从军械库里挑样东西赏你——可我做不到。那就把我从大主教那里得来的这本书送给你吧。$B$B有空常来跟我讲讲你的冒险，这座宫殿又沉闷又无聊。我需要一个朋友。

english: With this returned, so too does hope return. During the gospel this year, we will reconnect with those whose faith has dimmed, for that is exactly what they need amidst the chaos enveloping these lands.
old_奖励清单: 你将获得：哀嚎修女长袍
new_译文: 随着它被送回，希望也回来了。今年的福音仪式上，我们要与那些信仰已经黯淡的人重新连结——在这片土地被混乱笼罩之时，他们正需要这个。

english: You have slain that many? Good! Their blood will nourish the soil, and the grapes that grow from it will bear the sweet taste of victory.
old_奖励清单: 你可以从这些奖励中选择其一：火葬大师的兜帽、克劳福德锁甲
new_译文: 你杀了这么多？很好！它们的血会滋养土壤，长出的葡萄会带着胜利的甘甜。

english: Without their leaders, the remaining orcs should return to their filthy lands.
old_奖励清单: 你可以从这些奖励中选择其一：奥祖克的穿刺者、霸主之剑刃、钢牙
new_译文: 没了首领，残存的兽人该滚回他们肮脏的故土了。

english: I heard them blowing up from here. Great job, pick one of these.
old_奖励清单: 你可以从这些奖励中选择其一：琥珀木护腕、黑铁手套
new_译文: 我在这儿都听见它们炸开了。干得好，挑一件吧。

english: Good, here is your prize. May the Light smite you should you falter from its path.
old_奖励清单: 你将获得：琥珀披肩
new_译文: 很好，这是你的奖赏。若你偏离圣光之道，愿圣光惩罚你。

english: Fleshy return with smelly orc.$B$BWiggles carry back to master.$B$BSmelly lost this, fleshy keep.$B$BBye fleshy.
old_奖励清单: 你将获得：火葬大师的兜帽
new_译文: 肉肉的带回了臭兽人。$B$B卫葛斯要把它搬回去给主人。$B$B臭臭把它弄丢了，就归肉肉的了。$B$B再见，肉肉的。

english: You may keep that pouch, I no longer need it.
old_奖励清单: 你将获得：黑铁手套、魔纹包
new_译文: 那个袋子你留着吧，我已经用不着了。

english: A job well done, and a reward well deserved.
old_奖励清单: 你可以从这些奖励中选择其一：霸主之剑刃、奥祖克的穿刺者、钢牙
new_译文: 干得漂亮，这份奖励你当之无愧。

english: So Hawthorne deputized you as assistant for his investigations in Northwind. Let me see what results you have to show.$B$B<Shaw takes a thorough look through Hawthorne's journal and an even more thorough read over the letter you have found at the orc camp. With a stern expression, he rolls the parchment and shows you the seal at the end of it.>$B$BThis is the seal of the Stormreaver Clan. This is an old orc clan we believed to have perished at the end of the Second War. I have read through this letter and what's inside matches with the kingdom's ailments: They issued the abductions of careless citizens, but turned their focus to Northwind for some unknown reason. Still, this is not the most alarming revelation about this whole ordeal. But first, a reward for your assistance.
old_奖励清单: 你可以从这些奖励中选择其一：军情七处荣誉部落的勋章、刺客之护环、特工斗篷
new_译文: 所以霍桑把你雇为助手，帮他在北风查案。让我看看你查出了什么。$B$B<肖仔细翻过霍桑的日志，又把你在兽人营地找到的那封信读了更仔细的一遍。他神情严峻，把羊皮纸卷起，让你看末尾的印记。>$B$B这是风暴掠袭者氏族的印记。那是个古老的兽人氏族，我们本以为他们在二次大战末期就灭绝了。这封信我读完了，内容与王国的病症吻合：他们下令绑架疏于防范的平民，却不知为何把注意力转向了北风。不过，这还不是整桩事里最令人警觉的发现。先给你应得的奖励吧。

english: Wonderful, just retribution for trespassing into my lands, raiding Birkhaven and ruining my mining schedules! They've got what they had coming for them! I must thank you. Here, choose something to your liking, someone of your caliber more than deserved it.
old_奖励清单: 你可以从这些奖励中选择其一：贵族之毒刃、怜悯之腰带
new_译文: 太好了，这是他们闯进我的地盘、洗劫比尔克庇护所、搅乱我采石计划的报应！他们活该！我得谢谢你。来，挑一件合意的——以你的本事，远远配得上。

english: <The old hag grinds up the herbs in a mortar before mixing in the gooey ambersap. Stirring the ointment, she applies it onto a new bandage. Carefully removing the old one, another batch is spread over the little ducks wound, much to its dismay. With quick but delicate movements the witch wraps the bandage around its left wing, securing it in place.>$B$BThere, darling; this will help it recover very quickly. Defenseless creatures like our friend here rarely have such luck at meeting a kind soul like you. And judging by its behaviour, it recognizes your efforts just as much. Your actions formed a formidable bond today. Make sure to foster it greatly, as power lies deeply rooted in such connections.
old_奖励清单: 你将获得：比利
new_译文: <老太婆用药杵把草药捣碎，再拌入黏稠的琥珀树液。她搅匀药膏，涂到一条新绷带上。小心地取下旧绷带，又一批药膏敷在小鸭子的伤口上，疼得它好不委屈。女巫动作利落又轻柔地把绷带缠上它的左翼，固定妥当。>$B$B好了，宝贝；这能让它好得很快。像我们这位朋友这样毫无自保之力的小家伙，很少有幸遇到你这样的好心人。看它的样子，它同样记着你的付出。你的行为今日结下了一份了不起的羁绊。务必好好珍视——力量深深根植于这样的联系之中。

english: A pity, those were valuable agents we've lost today. I'll send missives to their families, their service to the Kingdom won't be forgotten. Now, regarding this scroll...
old_奖励清单: 你可以从这些奖励中选择其一：半溶解婚纱指环、酷刑之者马裤
new_译文: 可惜了，我们今天失去的都是得力的密探。我会给他们的家人送信，他们为王国所做的贡献不会被遗忘。现在，说说这卷轴……

english: Mission accomplished. Well done, $C. Sadly, I suspect we cannot ultimately cut off the demonic forces here with their warlocks still up and running. But we take any little victory we can get. Remember, this is a war against numbers, gotta use what you got to your advantage! Speaking of advantage, this tablet you brought with you has to contain crucial information about the demon's involvement in all of this. I just know it! I will bring it to Noppsy, he'll know what needs to be done.
old_奖励清单: 你将获得：哈瑞丽丝的鞭子
new_译文: 任务完成。干得好，$C。遗憾的是，只要那些术士还在活动，我们恐怕终究没法彻底切断这里的恶魔势力。但能拿到多少小胜，我们就拿多少。记住，这是一场拼数量的战争，得把手上的东西用到极致！说到优势——你带回来的这块石碑里，肯定藏着恶魔插手此事的关键情报。我就知道！我会把它带给诺普西，他知道该怎么办。
note: 「诺普西」= 62458 Noppsy Spickerspan

english: Ohoho, fine handiwork, friend. Those demon-hugging orcs will be in for a surprise once we press this detonator here and all the explosive goodness is just flying all around them!$B$B<Rufus' eyes are full of glee, to the point where he appears like an overly joyous bearded child.>$B$BHo, this reminds me of that one time I almost blew up the Dwarven District in Stormwind. I'll share the story with you over an ale after we're done brooding over this blasted island. An honest dwarven promise!
old_奖励清单: 你将获得：简易投掷炸弹
new_译文: 哦嚯嚯，好手艺啊，朋友。等我们按下这个起爆器，让那些爆炸的好东西在他们四周乱飞，那帮抱着恶魔大腿的兽人就有得瞧了！$B$B<鲁夫斯眼里满是狂喜，简直乐得像个胡子拉碴的孩子。>$B$B嚯，这让我想起有一回我差点把暴风城的矮人区给炸了。等我们为这该诅咒的岛屿操心完，我一边喝酒一边讲给你听。矮人一言为定！

english: My compass! Does that mean Verix got what he deserved? Good riddance to him, if you ask me. One goblin's misery is another goblin's fortune, as we like to say. With my compass back in my possession, all that is left is to repair the Gullwing into workable shape. Thank you for your help, $C. You can keep some of the coins that Verix looted. If you want to keep lending your hand, we won't say no.
old_奖励清单: 你可以从这些奖励中选择其一：地精鼻环指环、维里克斯的领航斗篷
new_译文: 我的罗盘！这么说维里克斯得到了他该得的下场？要我说，他死得好。我们哥布林有句话：一个哥布林的不幸，就是另一个哥布林的财运。罗盘回到我手里，剩下的就是把鸥翼号修到能用。谢谢你的帮忙，$C。维里克斯搜刮来的金币你可以留一些。要是你还想搭把手，我们绝不推辞。

english: I have to admit, I'm impressed. The others and I were waging with how many limbs you'd return or if we'd have to fish your limp body out of the ocean. Guess I'll owe Rikki some gold when we're back in Booty Bay. Regardless, incredible display of skills by you. Yunie will be relieved to have one less issue holding us back. If you're ever bored of adventuring around the world, the Steamwheedle Headquarters in Undermine are always in need of capable bruisers. Think about it, you'd fit right in!
old_奖励清单: 你可以从这些奖励中选择其一：潘妮的碎蟹器、招潮者胸甲
new_译文: 我得承认，我很佩服。我和其他人一直在赌你会带着几条肢体回来，还是我们得从海里把你的软身子捞上来。看来等我们回藏宝海湾，我得输给瑞克基几个金币了。不管怎么说，你的身手真是惊人。少了一个拖累，阿恩伊会松一口气。要是哪天你在外头冒险闯腻了，安德麦的热砂总部永远缺能打的狠角色。考虑一下，你准能融入进去！

english: Color me surprised, a whole treasure trove full of valuable materials. This alone should suffice for rebuilding the outer frame of the Gullwing. I have to say, I didn't expect you to be so successful. But that was to be expected for someone crazy enough to come to such a backwater island willingly, I suppose? Either way, we owe you one big time, friend. Goblin promise!
old_奖励清单: 你可以从这些奖励中选择其一：掠夺的海盗礼帽、涂焦油的护肩
new_译文: 真让我吃惊，整整一箱值钱的材料。光凭这些，就够重建鸥翼号的外框了。不得不说，我没想到你能办得这么漂亮。不过，愿意跑到这种穷乡僻壤小岛上来的人，本来就够疯的，是吧？总之，我们欠你一个大人情，朋友。哥布林一言为定！

english: An unusally biting odor. Extracting a functioning poison from them might take some time, but the result will be worth the effort tenfold. I must thank you, your assistance accelerates the success of this mission more than you'd think.
old_奖励清单: 你可以从这些奖励中选择其一：轻足莫卡辛鞋、治疗之护手
new_译文: 一股异常刺鼻的气味。要从它们身上提炼出可用的毒药得花些时间，但回报会十倍于所费。我得谢谢你——你的协助让这次任务的成功来得比你想的更快。

english: Naga, you say?! This is truly bad news. If these slithering demons are behind this phenomenon, then I dare not think what their true intentions are. For now we have thwarted their ambitions. However, I do wonder, has this pearl been here all along? If so, was it always broken? And if not, why was it brought here; and by whom? The naga or the murlocs? Many unanswered questions still lie before us and none of them seem to be easily answered. Either way, I must thank you for your assistance. Our findings today helped me gain a better understanding of Balor's unending storm. Once I return to Davenburg, I will send notice to the Council of Tides in Boralus about the pearl, as well as the naga's involvement in all of this. With their ongoing incursions onto Kul Tiras, I am afraid this won't be the last we've seen of them.$B$BPlease, take this as humble compensation for your deeds.
old_奖励清单: 你可以从这些奖励中选择其一：水术师兜帽、洞察之项圈。你将获得：珠光的碎片。
new_译文: 你说纳迦？！这真是坏消息。若这些蜿蜒爬行的恶徒是这现象背后的黑手，那他们的真正意图我简直不敢去想。眼下我们挫败了他们的图谋。不过我在想：这颗珍珠是一直都在这里吗？若是，它一直就是破碎的吗？若不是，它为何被带到这里，又是谁带来的？纳迦还是鱼人？仍有太多疑问摆在我们面前，而且似乎没有一个容易解答。无论如何，我必须感谢你的协助。今日的发现让我对巴罗无尽的风暴有了更深的理解。等我一回到达文堡，就会把珍珠以及纳迦牵涉其中的事，呈报给博拉勒斯的潮汐议会。以他们近来对库尔提拉斯的不断侵袭来看，恐怕这不会是最后一次。$B$B请收下这个，作为你所作所为的一点微薄补偿。

english: <Griselda is reading the dusty letter carefully, so as not to rip its paper with an unmindful move. A bittersweet expression hushes across the face, her eyes showing mild shock, but not the kind brought upon by bad news. Instead, a smile whisks itself upon her lips.>
old_奖励清单: 你将获得：水下诱鱼器
new_译文: <格里塞尔达小心翼翼地读着那封积尘的信，生怕一个不留神就扯破纸页。一丝苦涩而温柔的神情掠过她的脸，她眼中微露惊讶，却不是得知坏消息的那种。取而代之，一抹笑意爬上了她的嘴角。>
note: 两个同名 NPC：52026「格里希尔达」/ 62144「格里塞尔达提尔伊」；此处按自定义链取后者

english: Are you headed back into the Scholomance, $N? You've already paid such a great price for the use of the Divination Scryer - perhaps you'd like to take another one with you. With it, you'd be able to face the perils of the Great Ossuary once more.$B$BBy all means, have it. You've certainly earned it.
old_奖励清单: 你将获得：预言水晶球
new_译文: $N，你还要再进通灵学院？为使用预言水晶球，你已经付出了不小的代价——或许你愿意再带一个上路。有了它，你便能再次面对大骨库里的凶险。$B$B尽管拿去。这你受之无愧。

english: The day of victory has come at last, your actions have paved the way for the Horde to claim this land for itself. Thrall's wisdom is clear in your actions.$B$BYou shall be rewarded for your work this day.
old_奖励清单: 你可以从这些奖励中选择其一：荒野皮甲、痕织护腿、裂刃肩铠
new_译文: 胜利之日终于到来，你的行动为部落占据这片土地铺平了道路。你的作为里处处可见萨尔的智慧。$B$B今日的功劳，自当有赏。

english: I am pleased. To think one would betray their oaths, friends, and loyalties for power sickens me to my core. You have done the Horde a service in rooting out such a vile traitor.$B$BTake this, may it aid your cause even further.
old_奖励清单: 你可以从这些奖励中选择其一：变节者战斗长靴、泥牙法杖
new_译文: 我很满意。一想到有人为了力量背弃誓言、朋友与忠诚，我就从心底作呕。你为部落铲除了这样一个卑劣的叛徒。$B$B拿着这个，愿它助你的事业更进一步。

english: Such fine craftsmanship, you can tell goblin or gnomish hands touched such engineering.$B$BWith these parts I will be able to advance our efforts in Shatterblade Post even further.$B$BI must commend you for your work. Without the components and parts you have recovered this basecamp would be left in the stone age.$B$BTake one of these items, hopefully you will see use out of them.
old_奖励清单: 你可以从这些奖励中选择其一：哈莱克的战斗扳手、攻城工程师护目镜
new_译文: 好精良的工艺，一看就知道这工程出自哥布林或侏儒之手。$B$B有了这些零件，我就能让裂刃哨所的进展再快一步。$B$B我得夸夸你。没有你找回来的这些构件与零件，这座营地还停留在石器时代呢。$B$B挑一件东西吧，但愿它们能派上用场。

english: The power of the Uth'okk gemstone is flowing through my veins... Such power is euphoric!$B$BI am reborn, and I have you to thank for doing all my work.$B$B<Far Seer Mothang lets out a deep, and sinister laugh.>$B$BThe Pendant of Uth'okk has been sapped of its power, but I am sure you can make some use of it.$B$B<Far Seer Mothang lets off a deep smirk.>$B$BFarewell $C.
old_奖励清单: 你将获得：乌索克之坠饰
new_译文: 乌索克宝石的力量正流淌在我的血脉里……这般力量令人狂喜！$B$B我重生了，这都多亏你替我做了所有的事。$B$B<先知莫萨发出一阵低沉而阴森的笑。>$B$B乌索克之坠饰的力量已被抽干，不过我相信你还是能派上点用场。$B$B<先知莫萨露出一个意味深长的笑容。>$B$B再会了，$C。
note: 物品 41797 是「乌索克之坠饰」，但任务标题写「乌瑟克」——两者不一致，建议统一

english: I have done some studying while you were gone, and looked over the mechanism. I believe I may have figured out at the least how to power it, but in its state of decay I cannot guarantee this will work.$B$B<Tarwegg takes the materials, and begins to power the Ancient Power Module within the mechanism itself. With a soft click, the machine begins to whirr into life, albeit, at a slow, and decrepit pace.>$B$BAha! I have done it, I thank you for bringing the relic to me to study and work on, may its power help you on your journey.
old_奖励清单: 你将获得：充能圣物机关
new_译文: 你不在的时候我做了些研究，也把这机械装置看了一遍。我想至少弄清了该怎么给它供能，但以它现在这副朽坏的样子，我没法保证一定能成。$B$B<塔尔韦格接过材料，开始为装置内的远古能量模块充能。随着一声轻响，机器缓缓转动起来——虽然慢得可怜，还带着老旧的滞涩。>$B$B啊哈！我成功了，多亏你把这件遗物带来给我研究、动手。愿它的力量助你一路顺遂。

english: I can feel it, the flames corruption has been snuffed.$B$BYour efforts here are monumental, and without your help I would have been left nearly helpless. In time, the land should heal, and the elements should rest. I shall remain to study this transformation.$B$BAs a thanks for your actions, I offer you a reward worthy of your effort. Go with honor friend.
old_奖励清单: 你可以从这些奖励中选择其一：先知的护环、痕铸锁甲、远见之头巾、约尔塞格的权杖
new_译文: 我能感觉到——火焰中的腐化已经熄灭了。$B$B你在此地的付出意义重大，若没有你，我几乎束手无策。假以时日，这片土地会自我修复，元素也会归于安宁。我会留下来研究这场转变。$B$B为答谢你的作为，我送上一份配得上你辛劳的奖励。带着荣耀去吧，朋友。

english: Behold, a great power is now bestowed upon us. I never thought I would witness such a day when the sheer power of the goddess herself answered my call. The Scythe of Elune has been restored, and its power shall now lies within your hands to guard, and safekeep against the evils that encroach upon our world.$B$BWith such great power, shall come a great responsibility $C. It is entrusted upon you to uphold this artifact, and enact the will of Elune herself upon those that would threaten our purpose.
old_奖励清单: 你将获得：艾露恩之镰
new_译文: 看吧，一股伟大的力量已赐予我们。我从没想过能亲眼见到女神本身的力量回应我的召唤。艾露恩之镰已然复原，它的力量而今交由你保管，用以抵御侵蚀我们世界的邪恶。$B$B$C，如此强大的力量也意味着沉重的责任。守护这件神器、向那些威胁我们使命之人施行艾露恩的意志，都托付给你了。

english: You've recovered the residue, nice work. I must say I was not so sure it was responsible sending some traveler to clean up our mess, but it seems to have worked out in the end.$B$BPlease, on behalf of us here, take these potions, they may be of use on your journey.
old_奖励清单: 你将获得：初级法力药水
new_译文: 你把残留物取回来了，干得好。老实说，派一个路过的旅人来替我们收拾烂摊子，我本有些不放心，但看来结果还不错。$B$B请代表我们这些人，收下这些药水，也许你路上用得上。

english: The delivery of scrolls? Zaldimar must have sent you. I must admit, that I miss his presence at the tower, he was always such a skilled pupil.$B$BThese scrolls will be put to good use, I can assure you that. Please, take this, as a thanks from us at the Tower of Azora.
old_奖励清单: 你可以从这些奖励中选择其一：耐力卷轴、精神卷轴
new_译文: 送卷轴来的？一定是扎尔迪玛派你来的。老实说，我很想念他在塔里的日子——他一直是个出色的学生。$B$B这些卷轴会派上大用场，我向你保证。请收下这个，就当是阿祖拉之塔的一点谢意。

english: A bright mind has been lost this day. In another world perhaps he could have truly been one of the great wizards of Azeroth.$B$B<Theocritus lets out a deep, and long sigh.>$B$BI doubt I will find another like him, and still, I must thank you for doing what must be done. Take this, as a personal thanks from me, to you.
old_奖励清单: 你将获得：忒奥克里托斯的指环
new_译文: 今天失去了一位聪慧的心灵。也许在另一个世界，他真能成为艾泽拉斯的伟大法师之一。$B$B<塞欧克瑞图斯长长地叹了口气。>$B$B我想我再也找不到像他那样的人了，但我仍要谢谢你做了必须做的事。收下这个吧，这是我个人给你的谢意。

english: That's what I'm talking about! This beauty will pay a pretty sum of gold with those Shadowfo-... Oh, you're still here. Right! Your reward. Here, take this and some coin on top of it, you really made this goblin's day!
old_奖励清单: 你可以从这些奖励中选择其一：苔皮腰带、沼水手套、苔链护腕
new_译文: 这才像话！有了这宝贝，卖给那些暗炉……哦，你还在啊。对！你的奖赏。喏，拿着这个，再添几个金币——你可真让本哥布林今天走了大运！

english: <You don't have much time to react as you hand Grimbite the head of Gowlfang. With untamed wrath and hate, the gnoll tears the head out of your hand, before viciously biting into it, ravaging it into an unrecognizable state. After he is done, he tosses what is left into the near bog, letting it sink to the ground of the swamp. A yowling scream escapes Grimbite's jaw, the other gnolls follow suit. The howling persists for a few moments, echoing throughout all of the Wetlands.>$B$BGowlfang is dead! Mosshide now truly free! You member of Mosshide, forever. Take this, for killing Betrayer.
old_奖励清单: 你将获得：苔皮指环
new_译文: <你还来不及反应，就把孤峰的头颅递给了格里姆比泰。带着不加掩饰的暴怒与憎恨，这豺狼人一把夺过头颅，狠狠咬了下去，将它撕咬得面目全非。做完这一切，他把残余扔进近旁的泥沼，任其沉入沼底。一声嗥叫从格里姆比泰的喉间迸出，其余豺狼人也随之应和。嚎叫声持续了片刻，回荡在整片湿地上空。>$B$B孤峰死了！藓皮真正自由了！你，藓皮的成员，永远！拿着这个，为了杀死叛徒。
note: Mosshide 按官方 gnoll 译名「藓皮」

english: It is done. Life and death is a cycle that has to be maintained, and tainted life must be given the chance to bloom once more. The pain in my heart will continue to ache, yet I can be assured that Searistrasz is no longer in torment. Go in peace, mortal, and may your travels be without tragedy.
old_奖励清单: 你可以从这些奖励中选择其一：符文束缚的匕首、焰织腰带、燃烧怒气护腕
new_译文: 成了。生死是需要维系的循环，被污染的生命也该有重新绽放的机会。我心中的痛楚仍会持续，但至少我可以确信，斯伊瑞斯特尔阿斯兹不再受苦了。平安地去吧，凡人，愿你的旅途不再有悲剧。

english: You are a faithful and obedient servant, $C. For your subservience, a reward awaits. Have this and be on your way, the Dark Lady does not appreciate needless loitering.
old_奖励清单: 你将获得：古老烈焰坠饰
new_译文: 你是个忠诚听话的仆从，$C。为你的效命，我备了一份奖赏。拿着它上路吧——黑暗女王不喜欢有人在她的地盘上无故逗留。

english: A tablet about the Redbrand's past?! Incredible; quickly, let me inspect it!$B$B<Torwyn adjusts his lens and begins perusing his gaze across the tablet's stony surface. With each line he's deciphering and reading, he's becoming increasingly more red and sweaty, up until his hand is visibly shaking.>$B$BY-You…! WHERE DID YOU FIND THIS?! You will NEVER speak of this; never! No one is to know about this accursed tablet! Absolutely no one! Here, take this and your lips will remain sealed, am I clear?! Now begone!
old_奖励清单: 你可以从这些奖励中选择其一：砾织者马裤、多加尔之防御者、镶宝石的腰带
new_译文: 一块记载红印家族过往的石碑？！难以置信；快，让我看看！$B$B<托温调好镜片，目光扫过石碑的石面。随着他一行行辨认、读下去，他的脸越来越红、汗也越来越多，到最后手都明显抖了起来。>$B$B你——你……！这东西你从哪儿找来的？！你绝不许提，绝不许！这块该诅咒的石碑，谁都不能知道！绝对不行！来，拿着这个，你的嘴就给我闭紧，听明白了吗？！滚吧！

english: Good riddance. We've dealt a serious blow to whatever Dragonmaw remained in Khaz Modan. Now it is up to us to clear up the mess and dispose of any remaining vermin skulking around in our lands. I salute to you, $N. You're a true hero in my eyes.
old_奖励清单: 你可以从这些奖励中选择其一：米奈希尔甲护胫、坚心披肩、托尔威尔的护腕
new_译文: 死得好。卡兹莫丹残存的龙喉势力被我们狠狠打了一记。接下来就剩收拾残局，把还在我们地盘上乱窜的害虫清除干净。我向你致敬，$N。在我眼里，你就是真正的英雄。

english: I sense something deep within the heart of this creature... It yearned for release, to combat a darkness that lurked.$B$B<Kym Wildmane looks confused, and lets out a slight sigh.>$B$BPerhaps my original assessment was incorrect. It was not the primitive dark magic of the quilboar that awakened this natural being and sent it into madness. No, it was something much darker, and sinister... I have more questions that I must research further. You have done well, regardless of my pondering. Please, take this, as a thanks from myself.
old_奖励清单: 你可以从这些奖励中选择其一：野枝护腿、沼泽织物手套
new_译文: 我在这生物的心脏深处感觉到了什么……它在渴望解脱，去对抗潜伏的黑暗。$B$B<凯姆·蛮鬃一脸困惑，轻轻叹了口气。>$B$B也许我最初的判断错了。唤醒这自然之物、令它陷入疯狂的，并非野猪人那种原始的黑暗魔法。不，是更黑暗、更阴邪的东西……我还有太多疑问需要进一步研究。无论我如何思量，你做得都很好。请收下这个，作为我的一点谢意。

english: Such strange magic, I am unfamiliar with the lingering presence that drove these creatures.$B$BSuch energy is not of a natural origin. I must conduct further studies to find the truth. You have done well $N. Please, take these coins, may they serve you well.
old_奖励清单: 你可以从这些奖励中选择其一：野枝护腿、沼泽织物手套
new_译文: 如此诡异的魔法，那股盘踞在这些生物身上的气息我从未见过。$B$B这等能量绝非自然之物。我必须进一步研究才能查明真相。你干得好，$N。请收下这些金币，愿它们对你有用。

english: Frederik, old friend. Figments of your essence linger in this dull trinket, bare of any grandeur it once held. One day, when I may finally pass on and leave this realm, I will see you once more...$B$B$N, blessings upon you. This ring will find its way into oblivion, far away from the clutches of darkness, I will make sure of that. For your courageous act, take this from my remaining corporeal belongings. You deserve it well.
old_奖励清单: 你将获得：格拉汉家族圣印
new_译文: 弗雷德里克，老朋友。你的魂魄残影还留在这件暗淡的小玩意里，早已不复昔日的荣光。总有一天，当我终于离世、离开这方天地时，我会再见到你……$B$B$N，愿祝福与你同在。这枚戒指会被我送去远离黑暗魔掌的湮灭之地，我保证。为你的英勇之举，请收下这件我仅存的贴身之物。你当之无愧。
note: Frederik → 62042 弗雷德里克

english: I expected nothing less. For an external aid, you've proven yourself to be a valuable asset to our team. If the thrill of adventure ever subsides within you, the SI:7 has room for individuals like you.$B$BPlease, report your findings. Time is running out.
old_奖励清单: 你可以从这些奖励中选择其一：狡诈之扣环、海风披风
new_译文: 我没看错人。作为外来的助力，你已证明自己是队里不可多得的人才。若哪天冒险的刺激在你心里淡了，军情七处永远欢迎你这样的人。$B$B请把调查结果报上来。时间不多了。

english: So the control panels were tampered with, hm? Not really a surprise, but a nuisance nonetheless. As much as I hate to admit it, our technicians will have to double proof them to ensure their original functionality is being restored. We wouldn't want all this liquid gold just to blow up, alongside us!$B$BEither way, good work out there. Here, take these as compensation for the hassle; the Durotar Labor Union is in your favour!
old_奖励清单: 你将获得：卡克的油光手套
new_译文: 这么说，控制台被人动过手脚了？算不上意外，但终究是麻烦。虽然我不愿承认，可我们的技师得给它加双重保险，才能确保原本的功能恢复如初。总不能让这满满一池液体黄金连同我们一起炸上天吧！$B$B不管怎样，干得好。喏，收下这些，算是补偿你这番折腾——杜隆塔尔劳工联盟记你一份人情！

english: You were in Tanaris and helped out Celdi? How wonderful, that woman is a true blessing! When she first flounced around Sparkwater Port my eyes almost flew out of my skull. A high administrator of the Bilgewater Cartel here, in our small town?! And she wants to join us?! It felt like I had just doubled all my lifesavings in a last effort try at the casino. After the disaster that was Blackstone Island, the Durotar Labor Union desperately needed an uplift in profit AND morale. The oil rig in Tanaris was an excellent idea, if I were to be so humble. With Slickwick at the helm, I just knew it'd be a success.$B$BDespite that, the Venture Co.'s continued sabotage and intrusion worry me. I fear their patience runs dry, Razdunk never was one to remain calm when he doesn't get his way. Keep your ears and eyes sharp, $N. The future won't be easy for us.
old_奖励清单: 你可以从这些奖励中选择其一：滑芯柳条宝盒、重制的风险投资公司毒刃、碎片金属肩铠、首领斗殴者项圈
new_译文: 你去过塔纳利斯，还帮了塞尔迪？太好了，那女人真是上天的恩赐！她头一次在耀水港趾高气扬地晃悠时，我的眼珠子差点掉出来。锈水财阀的高层官员，跑到我们这小地方来？！还要加入我们？！那感觉就像我在赌场最后一搏，把一辈子的积蓄翻了一倍。黑石岛的惨败之后，杜隆塔尔劳工联盟急需利润与士气的双重提振。要我说句不自夸的话，塔纳利斯那座钻井平台的主意太妙了。有滑芯管事，我就知道一定能成。$B$B尽管如此，风险投资公司不断的破坏与侵入仍让我不安。我怕他们的耐心快耗尽了——拉兹敦从来不是个顺不了心还能平静的人。$N，把耳朵眼睛都放尖一点。我们的未来不会轻松。
note: Bilgewater Cartel 官方译「锈水财阀」（原句译为「污水港」不妥）

english: Does Lord Amberwood employ lowly peasants now to deliver royal documents? To be expected, but that matters little now.$B$BBe that as it may, you've done your assignment amicably. Still, my gratitude has limits. I have crucial information to analyze, so I would appreciate it if you would leave me to deal with the ailments of the kingdom in peace.
old_奖励清单: 你可以从这些奖励中选择其一：传承剑刃、虔诚光环之锤
new_译文: 琥珀木领主如今连送王室文书都雇起低贱的农夫了？倒也不出所料，不过现在这些都无关紧要了。$B$B无论如何，你的差事办得还算妥当。不过我的谢意也是有限度的——我还有关键的情报要分析，所以请你行个方便，让我安安静静处理王国的疾患。

english: <The Pedestal of Unity begins to click, and whirr into motion. A humming of foreign magic begins emanate, and the surface of the stone begins to glow blue. From the base of the stone pedestal emerges a tray which contains a singular key.>
old_奖励清单: 你将获得：下储备钥匙
new_译文: <团结之基开始咔哒作响，齿轮转动起来。一阵异样的魔力嗡鸣传来，石面泛起蓝光。基座下方缓缓伸出一个托盘，上面放着一枚孤零零的钥匙。>

english: <Lorekeeper Javon holds the crystal in one hand, the grimoire in the other. Reciting the incantations written on the pages, the nexus crystal begins to move, agitated by the swell of arcane power. Increasing in intensity, the rapid movements peak before breaking under vibrant purple sparks, leaving two golden shards in Javon's hand.>$B$BSuccess! That was marvelous, truly! I am amazed how close to perfect Aszune's spells are. With a bit of practice and refinement, we will be able to quickly and more safely break apart nexus crystals with ease.$B$B$N, thank you for your cooperation. You can keep these shards as a reward for your assistance. Please, bring me any nexus crystal you can find, so that I may continue my experimentations.
old_奖励清单: 你将获得：大块魔光碎片
new_译文: <博学者亚沃一手握水晶，一手捧魔典。他念出书页上的咒语，枢纽水晶开始动起来，被涌起的奥术能量激得震颤。震动越来越剧烈，在炫目的紫色火花中骤然破碎，留下两枚金色碎片在他手中。>$B$B成功了！太精彩了，真的！我很惊讶阿苏恩的法术竟近乎完美。稍加练习与改良，我们就能轻松、更安全地快速分解枢纽水晶了。$B$B$N，谢谢你的配合。这些碎片你留着，算作你协助的奖赏。请继续把你能找到的枢纽水晶带给我，好让我接着做实验。
note: Aszune 库内无词条，试译「阿苏恩」

english: <Crackling energy shoots out from the magical shards, while Javon recites the spell. Heat begins to emanate from his hand and the pieces begin to form a liquid union, hovering slightly in the air. Shortly after, a burst of mana erupts - and in Javon's hand lies a nexus crystal.>$B$BSplendid, seeing it unfold right before my eyes is something I will remember forever. To think what we've achieved today was only possible because of ten-thousand year old knowledge, wisdom my people treasured for millennia is a testament to our resilience. Don't fret, young $C, without your aid, all of this would not have been possible. Please keep the crystal as your reward. I am adamant that we can refine the process even further, so I would be pleased if you'd gather the needed components once again.
old_奖励清单: 你将获得：连结水晶
new_译文: <亚沃念咒之时，魔法碎片迸出噼啪作响的能量。热量自他掌中升腾，碎片化作液态彼此融合，微微悬在空中。片刻之后，一阵法力迸发——亚沃手中多了一枚枢纽水晶。>$B$B太棒了。亲眼看着它在我面前成形，这一幕我会永远记得。想想看，我们今日的成果竟有赖于一万年前的知识——我族珍视千年的智慧，正是我们韧性的明证。别发愁，年轻的$C，没有你的帮助，这一切都不可能。请留下这枚水晶作为奖赏。我坚信这工艺还能进一步改良，所以若你愿意再采集一次所需材料，我会很高兴。

english: <Placing the books on Noppsy's table, the gnome marvels at the proportionally gigantic tomes.>$B$BSo beautiful and ancient! It will take some time to study these documents thoroughly. Thank you, $N. You've done a great service to the kingdom today, preserving part of their history, as ugly and depressing as it may be. These stories tell us valuable lessons, so barring your eyes from them will only hurt you in the long run. Remember, knowledge is key to your survival.
old_奖励清单: 你将获得：档案员的腰带
new_译文: <把书搁到诺普西的桌上，这个侏儒惊叹于这些比例夸张的巨册。>$B$B如此精美，如此古老！要通读这些文献得花些时间。谢谢你，$N。你今天为王国做了一件大好事——保全了他们历史的一部分，哪怕它丑陋又令人沮丧。这些故事能教给我们宝贵的教训，所以对它们视而不见，长远来看只会害了你。记住，知识是你活下去的关键。

english: What travesties have transpired at this place...? Never have I witnessed such horrors in my life, the thought of such profanities even existing send shivers down my spine.$B$B$N, your bravery in descending this spiral of madness is a heroic feat rarely seen nowadays. Your service to the kingdom and all of the Alliance this day will be remembered by those present and cherished by those affected. These rewards do not match the magnitude of your deeds, but take them nevertheless.$B$BYou are dismissed.
old_奖励清单: 你可以从这些奖励中选择其一：鲁弗斯的可靠酒杯、金里尔的刀、诺普西的汇编、尼普西的精准步枪
new_译文: 这地方究竟发生了怎样的惨剧……？我一生从未见过如此恐怖之事，光是想到这等亵渎之物存在，就让我脊背发凉。$B$B$N，你敢深入这疯狂漩涡，是如今难得一见的英雄之举。你今日为王国、为整个联盟所做的贡献，在场者会铭记，受惠者会珍视。这些奖励配不上你功绩的分量，但还请你收下。$B$B你可以退下了。

english: So... it is done. A necessary task, and performed adequately.$B$B<He pauses, gaze drifting toward the tainted moonwell, voice lowering with unease.>$B$BAnd yet... a shadow lingers in my thoughts.$B$BWhat if Ursol himself has fallen? What if the silence is not from disdain, but from madness... corruption?$B$B<His tone grows cold, edged with quiet alarm.>$B$BA dangerous thought. One I dare not entertain lightly. The Archdruid must hear of this.$B$BYou have my thanks for your... assistance. May the winds carry you far from this cursed place.
old_奖励清单: 你可以从这些奖励中选择其一：熊怪长裤、悼影便鞋
new_译文: 那么……办完了。必要的差事，完成得也算妥当。$B$B<他顿了顿，目光飘向被污染的月亮井，声音因不安而低沉。>$B$B然而……一道阴影仍盘踞在我心头。$B$B倘若乌索尔本人也堕落了呢？倘若这沉默并非出于轻蔑，而是疯狂……腐化？$B$B<他的语气转冷，透出一丝低抑的惊惶。>$B$B这是个危险的念头，我不敢轻率地放在心上。大德鲁伊必须知道此事。$B$B多谢你的……协助。愿风把你带离这被诅咒的地方。
note: Ursol → 库内「乌索尔」

english: Mmh... You have done what was necessary, mortal.$B$BTheir minds are finally still. No more Skardyn whispers. No more chains of twisted magic. Only silence... and the long sleep they were denied.$B$BDo not mourn them. Their fire now fuels our purpose—their last act will burn brighter than their madness ever did.
old_奖励清单: 你将获得：优质治疗药水
new_译文: 嗯……凡人，你做了必须做的事。$B$B他们的心智终于静下来。再没有斯卡丁的低语，再没有扭曲魔法的锁链。只剩下寂静……和被剥夺已久的沉眠。$B$B不必为他们哀悼。他们的火焰如今点燃了我们的意志——他们最后的行为，会比他们曾有的疯狂燃烧得更亮。

english: At last... the taint lifts.$B$B<His wings flex slightly as the oppressive weight of dark magic dissipates, the air itself seeming to sigh in relief. The swamp's murky waters ripple as if awakening from a long nightmare.>$B$BGrim Hollow will mend. The earth remembers how to heal... given time.$B$BYet this victory is but one ember plucked from a wildfire. The Skardyn do not act alone—they are rats fleeing a sinking nest. Grim Batol has spat out more of their kind, scattered like rot across Khaz Modan.$B$BAnd worst of all... they scurry with purpose. This was no mere exile. They serve something. Something old. Something hungry.$B$BMark my words, mortal—this is not over. Whatever they plan... we must find it before it finds us.$B$BAnd next time... the fire we bring may not be enough.
old_奖励清单: 你可以从这些奖励中选择其一：中空的者护手、斯卡丁暗法师长袍、无情角斗士的统御裹腕
new_译文: 终于……那股污秽散去了。$B$B<随着黑暗魔法沉重的压迫消退，他的双翼微微舒展，空气本身仿佛都松了一口气。沼泽浑浊的水面泛起涟漪，像是从漫长的噩梦中醒来。>$B$B格里姆谷会痊愈的。大地记得如何愈合……只要给它时间。$B$B可这场胜利只是从野火上摘下一粒火星。斯卡丁并非独自行动——他们是逃离沉船的鼠辈。格瑞姆巴托吐出了更多同类，像腐斑一样散布在卡兹莫丹。$B$B而最糟的是……他们逃窜得井然有序。这不只是一次流放。他们在侍奉什么。某种古老的东西。某种饥渴的东西。$B$B记住我的话，凡人——这事没有结束。无论他们谋划什么……我们都必须在它找到我们之前先找到它。$B$B而下一次……我们带来的火，恐怕不够。
note: Grim Hollow 试译「格里姆谷」

english: It is done. This Verdant Rune is tethered to the essence of the World Tree in conjunction with the Runestones. Focus your mind on its potent magic, and your spirit will find itself anew here, at the foot of Nordrassil.
old_奖励清单: 你将获得：绿色符文
new_译文: 成了。这枚翠绿符文与符文石一同系于世界之树的精魂之上。凝神体会它的力量吧，你的灵魂将在此地——诺达希尔脚下——重获新生。

english: Such beauty- such magnificence. I wish I could have personally laid eyes upon the ancient tree, though I thank you for the efforts you have taken to recover this. I am within your debt. Please, on behalf of us druids, take this as thanks.
old_奖励清单: 你将获得：星花指环
new_译文: 如此美丽——如此宏伟。我多希望能亲眼见到那棵古树，不过还是谢谢你费心将它寻回。我欠你一份人情。请代表我们德鲁伊，收下这份谢礼。

english: Magni's beard, an entire crate of it! So lucky this stuff doesn't go bad easily. Here you go, have some yourself.
old_奖励清单: 你将获得：巴罗一月光酒
new_译文: 麦格尼的胡子啊，整整一箱！还好这玩意儿不容易变质。来，你也拿点尝尝。

english: While in poor condition, it is still the crown of a duke. This will prove those rascals in the Halls of Explorers wrong! Thank you, $R. Here is what I promised.
old_奖励清单: 你可以从这些奖励中选择其一：喝水半角、附魔玻璃弯刀
new_译文: 虽然保存得不好，它终究还是公爵的冠冕。这下能让探险者大厅那帮无赖闭嘴了！谢谢你，$R。这是我答应你的东西。

english: I am proud of the hunter you have become. Choose something of mine to carry as a memento of your success.
old_奖励清单: 你可以从这些奖励中选择其一：狼兄弟、芬里斯之记忆、灰烬之肤
new_译文: 我为你成为一名猎人而骄傲。挑一件我的东西带走吧，就当是你成功的纪念。

english: O'jin is on the right path; he has done well to send you instead of coming himself. A chieftain must know how to make the proper choice. This is valuable information, and for your trouble, a reward is due. There may come a time when I will seek your aid in dealing with this issue. I will return to my duties and soon speak with the Warchief. Beware of the shadows, $N, especially where they dance freely.
old_奖励清单: 你将获得：暗矛巫毒瓶
new_译文: 奥金走对了路——派你来而不是自己来，做得不错。一个酋长必须懂得做出恰当的选择。这是很有价值的情报，你辛苦了，该有奖励。也许有一天，我会请你协助处理这件事。我要回去履职，很快就会与大酋长商议。当心阴影，$N，尤其是它们肆意起舞的地方。

english: A mercy far too great for scum like them. Take these; they will carry the light of An'she with you through grim lands.
old_奖励清单: 你将获得：吻阳护肩
new_译文: 对他们这种渣滓来说，这已是天大的仁慈。拿着吧，它们会带着安舍的光辉，陪你走过阴沉的荒野。

english: Uda'pe was right to send you to me. Though we are not very fond of working with the Horde, you have my thanks and will be paid accordingly.$B$BI will even add a bonus for being so silent and respectful—Uda'pe taught you well.
old_奖励清单: 你可以从这些奖励中选择其一：左、右、安舍之图腾
new_译文: 乌达佩把你派到我这儿来是对的。虽说我们不太愿意与部落打交道，但你的辛劳我记下了，报酬会照付。$B$B看在你话少又懂分寸的份上，我再加一份红包——乌达佩把你教得很好。

english: Stand proud child of the Horde. Victory is honorably achieved by those with strength and thunder in their blood.
old_奖励清单: 你将获得：改装的军情七处匕首
new_译文: 骄傲地站直了，部落的子民。唯有血中奔涌着力量与雷霆之人，才能赢得光荣的胜利。

english: Though it is not bound to be the last time we see the embers of the Shadow Council, a great victory was won. While we wish nothing from the land of Balor, it has given me the greatest gift.$B$BKilrogg was spiteful in the beginning, jealous of Grommash's celebration as a hero—while he himself seemed forgotten. But he was wrong to envy Grommash. My older brother merely set the foundation. It is you, and I, and Kilrogg who will build our future. I am glad he sees it that way now.
old_奖励清单: 你可以从这些奖励中选择其一：库卡隆头冠、巫毒皮甲、图腾师头饰
new_译文: 尽管我们未必是最后一次见到暗影议会的余烬，但这一场胜利意义非凡。我们对巴罗那片土地并无所求，它却给了我最好的礼物。$B$B基尔罗格起初满怀怨怼，嫉妒格罗玛什被当作英雄庆贺——而他自己却似被遗忘。可他嫉妒错了。我的兄长只是打下了地基。真正将建立未来的，是你、是我，也是基尔罗格。我很高兴他如今也这样看了。

english: Both fragments together will now serve as the key to enter the ruins of the castle. Beware, for you will face both servants of the Legion and cultists of those long forgotten.
old_奖励清单: 你将获得：风暴城堡钥匙
new_译文: 两块碎片合在一起，就能当作进入城堡废墟的钥匙。当心，你要面对的是燃烧军团的爪牙，还有那些早已被遗忘的邪教信徒。

english: Oh, more dusty than my grandmother back in Ironforge. Time has not been kind to this old tome, and the humid air is not exactly helping either. I will seal it properly in my chest and begin analysis back in the SI:7 headquarters. For you, $N, my heartfelt gratitude. Please choose a reward fitting for your service.
old_奖励清单: 你可以从这些奖励中选择其一：上古斩击者、多袋锁甲
new_译文: 哦，比我铁炉堡的奶奶还灰头土脸。时间没善待这本古籍，潮湿的空气更是雪上加霜。我会把它妥善封进箱子，然后带回军情七处总部做分析。$N，我由衷感谢你。请挑一件与你的付出相称的奖赏。

english: Wow, what a haul. Might not be exactly what we were supposed to be delivering, but I doubt those greedy bastards in their pirate cove will complain that much. Thank you so much, $N. We owe you big time. You can have this for your troubles, it always gave me the best of luck - the fact I’m still here is proof of that.
old_奖励清单: 你将获得：可靠的哥布林短刀
new_译文: 哇，收获不小。也许不是我们该送的那批货，但我想海盗湾里那帮贪心的家伙不会太计较。太感谢你了，$N。我们欠你一个大人情。这件东西你拿去，它一直给我带来好运——我还能站在这儿就是证明。

english: You've found it... By the Sunwell, I can scarcely believe it.$B$B<Ranger Feallina lifts the crystal, tilting it toward the light. The sun dances across its flawless facets, refracting a cascade of colors.>$B$BThis... this is no mere gem. It is a masterpiece — a testament to craftsmanship long thought lost.$B$BYou have our deepest thanks, $C. We will move swiftly now — the rangers and I shall descend upon the site and recover as many of these crystals as we can... before reporting back to Lord Theron.$B$BYou have rendered a great service to the Quel'dorei this day, my friend. May the light of the stars guide your path always.
old_奖励清单: 你可以从这些奖励中选择其一：远行者小屋守卫胸甲、远行者小屋守卫护腿
new_译文: 你找到了……以太阳之井起誓，我几乎不敢相信。$B$B<游侠菲亚琳娜举起水晶，斜对着光。阳光在它无瑕的切面上跳跃，折射出层层虹彩。>$B$B这……这绝不是普通宝石。这是一件杰作——是久已失传的手艺的明证。$B$B$C，我们由衷感谢你。我们这就行动——我和游侠们会赶赴现场，尽可能多地回收这种水晶……然后再向瑟伦领主复命。$B$B朋友，你今日为奎尔多雷立下了大功。愿星光永远指引你的道路。
note: Ranger Feallina 库内无词条，试译「菲亚琳娜」

english: <Groldan glares at the heads you've brought him and spits on the ground.>$B$BHa! That'll send a clear message to those Shadowforge rats! It's only a matter of time before word of this reaches their so-called leadership. Let this be a lesson to them—think twice before crossing the dwarves of Ironforge, or pay the bloody price!
old_奖励清单: 你可以从这些奖励中选择其一：丹基塔斯护肩、冷酷披风
new_译文: <格罗尔丹盯着你带来的人头，朝地上啐了一口。>$B$B哈！这会给暗炉那些鼠辈一个再清楚不过的信号！消息传到他们那位所谓的领袖耳朵里只是时间问题。就当是个教训——惹铁炉堡的矮人之前，最好先掂量掂量，否则就得付出血的代价！

english: Amazing work, $R! I'll send the miners in at once. In just a few days, we'll be back to mining, and with it, Dun Kithas will see its glory restored once more.$B$BPlease, take this. It's been in my family for generations, but now... now it's time for it to taste blood again. You've earned it.
old_奖励清单: 你可以从这些奖励中选择其一：丹基塔斯头盔、冷酷束带
new_译文: 干得漂亮，$R！我这就让矿工们进场。用不了几天，我们就能重新开采，丹基塔斯也能再度恢复往日的荣光。$B$B请收下这个。它在我家传了好几代，但现在……是时候让它再次尝尝血的味道了。这是你应得的。

english: The news of the Butcher's demise brings a certain satisfaction, I'll admit. Hopefully, that'll be the last we see of those murlocs. Now, I can finally focus on what truly matters—the war with the Dragonmaw. We've got bigger fish to fry.
old_奖励清单: 你可以从这些奖励中选择其一：空握手套、丹基塔斯护腿
new_译文: 屠夫的死讯传来，老实说，我很痛快。希望这是最后一次见到那些鱼人。现在我总算能专心于真正要紧的事——与龙喉的战争。我们还有更大的鱼要收拾。

english: You've done us proud, lad.$B$BTo see this banner again… aye, it stirs the heart. The orcs defiled our walls, but they couldn't claim our spirit.$B$BWith this flying once more above Dun Kithas, our people will remember who we are — and what we're fighting for.$B$BWell done.
old_奖励清单: 你将获得：巴戈斯之盾牌
new_译文: 你让我们感到骄傲，小子。$B$B再次看到这面战旗……是啊，让人热血沸腾。兽人践踏了我们的城墙，却夺不走我们的精神。$B$B它重新飘扬在丹基塔斯上空，我们的人民就会记起自己是谁——以及我们为何而战。$B$B干得好。

english: <Dorthas squints at the samples, turning them over in his hands. His expression darkens.>$B$BJust as I feared… this isn't some random corruption. This is the Shadow Curse—the same blight Modgud unleashed on Grim Batol during the war.$B$BAnd it's still active. Even after all these years, the curse is seeping out, spreading past the ruins. Stone can't hold it back. Time hasn't weakened it. If no one acts… this whole region could fall. This is beyond anything we can handle alone. I'll send word to the mages in Dalaran. They need to know what's happening. As for us… all we can do now is keep watch—and pray.
old_奖励清单: 你将获得：强效治疗药水
new_译文: <多尔萨斯眯眼看着样本，在手中来回翻动。他的表情阴沉下来。>$B$B正如我所担心的……这不是什么随机产生的腐化。这是暗影诅咒——正是当年莫德古德在格瑞姆巴托释放的那种灾厄。$B$B而且它至今仍在活动。这么多年过去，诅咒依然在渗出、蔓延，越过废墟。石头挡不住它，时间也没能削弱它。若无人出手……整片区域都会沦陷。这已远超我们独自应付的范畴。我会传信给达拉然的法师们，他们必须知道发生了什么。至于我们……眼下只能守望，并祈祷。

english: <Harfig listens closely as you recount the battle. His weathered face softens for the first time. A faint, tired smile creases the edges of his mouth.>$B$BAye… that's the news I've been needing to hear. You gave 'em hell, didn't you? I can feel it in my chest—like a weight's been lifted, if only a little.$B$BI'll never hold my son again… never hear his laugh echo through the halls…$B$BBut thanks to you, some other parent might.
old_奖励清单: 你将获得：废爪
new_译文: <哈尔菲格仔细听你讲述战斗经过。他饱经风霜的脸第一次松缓下来，嘴角浮起一丝疲惫的笑。>$B$B是啊……这正是我一直想听到的消息。你把他们打得够狠，是吧？我胸口都感觉到了——像是有副重担挪开了，哪怕只挪开一点。$B$B我再也没法抱住我的儿子……再也听不到他的笑声在厅堂里回荡……$B$B但多亏了你，别的父母也许还能。

english: The crystal!$B$B<Grukson turns it over in his hands, clearly impressed.>$B$BIt's just how I imagined it—absolutely perfect. This will make the mace something truly special.$B$BI'd better get to work, then. Maybe this time… my father will finally see what I'm capable of.
old_奖励清单: 你将获得：岩须护符
new_译文: 水晶！$B$B<格鲁克森在手中翻看着它，显然十分满意。>$B$B和我设想的一模一样——完美无缺。这把锤子会因此变得非同凡响。$B$B那我得赶紧动手了。也许这一次……父亲终于会看到我的本事。

english: <Magistrate Hurdam Toughhand listens intently, clearly impressed>$B$BBy the forge and stone, you've done more than I dared hope for! The folk of Dun Kithas and the Grim Reaches owe you a great debt. Take this reward as a token of our thanks.$B$BBut don't let your guard down yet—there's still Dragonmaw scum skulking in the hills, and we dwarves know better than to trust the peace of a mountain too soon. Stay sharp, and keep your axe ready.
old_奖励清单: 你可以从这些奖励中选择其一：丹基塔斯胸甲、治安官的宽檐帽、斯托尔加兹护肩
new_译文: <地方法官胡尔达姆仔细听着，显然大为赞叹。>$B$B以熔炉与磐石起誓，你做到的远比我敢期望的更多！丹基塔斯与格里姆高地的居民欠你一份大人情。请收下这份奖励，作为我们的谢意。$B$B但也别就此松懈——山里还有龙喉的渣滓在游荡。我们矮人最清楚，山中的太平是万万轻信不得的。保持警觉，斧头别离手。

english: <Magistrate Hurdam Toughhand looks on with a slight gaze of disbelief>$B$BYou were successful? By my beard, I cannot believe it!$B$BMany long and hard fought battles will have been avoided thanks to your hard work. The dwarves of Dun Kithas are forever in your favor! Please, take one of these items, as a reward from all of us here.
old_奖励清单: 你可以从这些奖励中选择其一：厄运之歌护腕、扎姆格斯之腰带、格斯卡尔的护腿
new_译文: <地方法官胡尔达姆带着几分难以置信看着你。>$B$B你成功了？以我的胡子起誓，我简直不敢相信！$B$B多亏你的辛劳，许多漫长而艰苦的战斗得以避免。丹基塔斯的矮人会永远记着你的恩情！请从这些东西里挑一件，就当是我们所有人的谢礼。
note: NPC 全名「地方法官胡尔达姆特奥哈恩德」，对话里用「胡尔达姆」

english: I must warn you, use this recipe wisely. A misuse of the materials can create the exact opposite of the Concoction of the Emerald Mongoose.$B$BI suggest you follow this recipe closely.
old_奖励清单: 你将获得：配方：翡翠猫鼬药剂
new_译文: 我必须提醒你，这配方要用得谨慎。材料一旦用错，做出来的东西会与翡翠猫鼬药剂截然相反。$B$B建议你严格照着配方来。

english: You've returned — and with the Crests of Heroism no less. Your efforts in these treacherous places haven't gone unnoticed. With each victory, our foothold grows stronger.$B$BThe Alliance thanks you for your bravery.
old_奖励清单: 你将获得：战争补给品宝箱
new_译文: 你回来了——还带回了英雄勋章。你在那些险恶之地所做的努力并非无人知晓。每一场胜利，都让我们的立足之地更加稳固。$B$B联盟为你的英勇致谢。

english: These relics speak for themselves. Incindis is no more, and the Sorcerer-Thane's hand lies still.$B$BThe Firelord will feel this blow and know the Alliance stands ready to snuff out his flames again, if need be. Take this cache, and remain prepared. There may be more lurking in the depths.
old_奖励清单: 你将获得：熔岩补给品宝箱
new_译文: 这些圣物已说明一切。伊恩辛迪斯不复存在，巫师领主的手也再难抬起。$B$B火焰之王会感受到这一击，并明白联盟随时准备再次熄灭他的烈焰——只要需要。收下这批补给，保持戒备。深处也许还潜伏着更多。

english: These crests will send a message, loud and clear. You've proven your strength once again. We'll push further with this momentum.$B$BTake your reward, champion. Stay sharp. The war does not rest - and neither do we.
old_奖励清单: 你将获得：战争补给品宝箱
new_译文: 这些徽章会传出清晰响亮的讯息：你再次证明了自己的力量。我们要借着这股势头继续推进。$B$B收下你的奖励，勇士。保持警觉，战争不会停歇——我们也不会。

english: You return bearing the crests of victory. Good. These show the enemy that their darkness cannot withstand our strength. With each blow you strike, you carve the path forward for the Horde.$B$BYour loyalty will not be forgotten.
old_奖励清单: 你将获得：战争补给品宝箱
new_译文: 你带着胜利的徽章回来了。很好。这些足以让敌人明白：他们的黑暗挡不住我们的力量。你每挥出一击，都为部落开辟前路。$B$B你的忠诚不会被遗忘。

english: These relics speak for themselves. Incindis is no more, and the Sorcerer-Thane's hand lies still.$B$BThe Firelord will feel this blow and know the Horde stands ready to snuff out his flames again, if need be. Take this cache, and remain prepared. There may be more lurking in the depths.
old_奖励清单: 你将获得：熔岩补给品宝箱
new_译文: 这些圣物已说明一切。伊恩辛迪斯不复存在，巫师领主的手也再难抬起。$B$B火焰之王会感受到这一击，并明白部落随时准备再次熄灭他的烈焰——只要需要。收下这批补给，保持戒备。深处也许还潜伏着更多。

english: Such magic, foul and intense! This be right what I was lookin' for. You've done well and traveled far. I offer you protection from the shadow, use it wisely and wander safely.
old_奖励清单: 你将获得：滋补药剂、保护卷轴 III
new_译文: 好浓烈的邪门法术！这正是我要找的东西。你干得好，也跑得够远。我送你一份阴影的庇护，善加使用，一路平安。

english: Excellent work. These crests are proof that you've broken their lines and shattered their resolve. We'll use this momentum to press further into their strongholds.$B$BTake this cache and be ready. We may need you again soon.
old_奖励清单: 你将获得：战争补给品宝箱
new_译文: 干得漂亮。这些徽章证明你击穿了他们的防线，粉碎了他们的意志。我们要借这股势头深入他们的据点。$B$B收下这批补给，做好准备——也许很快又需要你。

english: It pains me to ask of such things... The Blackroot were once our friends and dearest allies. As much as it hurts to look upon familiar faces and see friends, it is good to know they are now free from the evil that gripped their hearts. You have done the Timbermaw proud, and for that, you shall be rewarded friend.
old_奖励清单: 你可以从这些奖励中选择其一：巢穴守护者马靴、苍皮斗篷、腐皮腰带
new_译文: 提出这样的请求让我难受……黑根部族曾是我们的朋友和最亲近的盟友。尽管看着熟悉的面孔、认出昔日的朋友令人心痛，但知道他们已从盘踞心中的邪恶中解脱，还是让我欣慰。你为木喉争了光，朋友，为此你应当得到奖赏。

english: Behold, the creation of my people, the great Sapta of Tranquility. Able to guide ones movements with speed and grace. The very essence of the Timbermaw Sap has been imbued with our strength and given us the boons we have in this world.$B$BYour efforts in helping our tribe have earned you the right to our most traditional Sapta.
old_奖励清单: 你将获得：宁静灵药
new_译文: 看吧，这是我族人的造物——伟大的宁静灵契。它能以迅捷与优雅引导一个人的行动。木喉树液的精魂本身被注入了我们的力量，赋予了我们在这世上所拥有的恩赐。$B$B你为部族所做的努力，已为你赢得使用我们最传统灵契的权利。

english: Behold, the creation of my people, the great Sapta of Communion. It can empower ones resistance to the natural world in order to seek guidance. The very essence of the Timbermaw Sap has been imbued with our strength and given us the boons we have in this world.$B$BYour efforts in helping our tribe have earned you the right to our most traditional Sapta.
old_奖励清单: 你将获得：神性灵药
new_译文: 看吧，这是我族人的造物——伟大的共心灵契。它能增强人对自然世界的抵御，以便寻求指引。木喉树液的精魂本身被注入了我们的力量，赋予了我们在这世上所拥有的恩赐。$B$B你为部族所做的努力，已为你赢得使用我们最传统灵契的权利。

english: Behold, the creation of my people, the great Sapta of Harmony. It can empower and embolden the roots of nature itself. The very essence of the Timbermaw Sap has been imbued with our strength and given us the boons we have in this world.$B$BYour efforts in helping our tribe have earned you the right to our most traditional Sapta.
old_奖励清单: 你将获得：和谐灵药
new_译文: 看吧，这是我族人的造物——伟大的和谐灵契。它能强化并鼓舞自然本身的根须。木喉树液的精魂本身被注入了我们的力量，赋予了我们在这世上所拥有的恩赐。$B$B你为部族所做的努力，已为你赢得使用我们最传统灵契的权利。

english: Behold, the creation of my people, the great Sapta of Kinship. It can revitalize the most broken of spirits, and raise morale. The very essence of the Timbermaw Sap has been imbued with our strength and given us the boons we have in this world.$B$BYour efforts in helping our tribe have earned you the right to our most traditional Sapta.
old_奖励清单: 你将获得：亲源灵药
new_译文: 看吧，这是我族人的造物——伟大的亲缘灵契。它能让最破碎的灵魂重获生机，并提振士气。木喉树液的精魂本身被注入了我们的力量，赋予了我们在这世上所拥有的恩赐。$B$B你为部族所做的努力，已为你赢得使用我们最传统灵契的权利。

english: Behold, the creation of my people, the great Sapta of Resilience. It can offer protection against the corruption and poison that dwells deep in the forests. The very essence of the Timbermaw Sap has been imbued with our strength and given us the boons we have in this world.$B$BYour efforts in helping our tribe have earned you the right to our most traditional Sapta.
old_奖励清单: 你将获得：韧性灵药
new_译文: 看吧，这是我族人的造物——伟大的坚韧灵契。它能抵御深藏林中的腐化与剧毒。木喉树液的精魂本身被注入了我们的力量，赋予了我们在这世上所拥有的恩赐。$B$B你为部族所做的努力，已为你赢得使用我们最传统灵契的权利。

english: $N! You're here! As soon as I saw them return to the lodge, I knew you were successful, yet I still feared for your safety. You have my deepest gratitude. Not only did you risk your life for the innocent, but also braved dangers beyond what the usual adventurer faces.$B$BPlease, have one of these as a token of the good deeds you fulfilled this day.$N!
old_奖励清单: 你可以从这些奖励中选择其一：治疗药水、次级法力药水
new_译文: $N！你来了！一看到他们回到小屋，我就知道你成功了，可我还是为你的安危担心。我由衷感谢你。你不仅为无辜者冒了性命，还闯过了寻常冒险者根本不会遇上的凶险。$B$B请从这些东西里挑一件，作为你今日善举的见证。$N！

english: Ah yes, these trinkets have faired well, spared from the flame. I must thank you for all that you have done outsider. Without your help, these surely would have been destroyed. I can only offer you a paltry reward, I just hope it is enough to convey my thanks.
old_奖励清单: 你可以从这些奖励中选择其一：海岸行者长靴、河川流手套
new_译文: 啊，是的，这些小玩意完好地躲过了火焰。外来者，我得谢谢你做的一切。没有你，它们肯定已经被毁了。我只能奉上微薄的报酬，但愿这点心意足够表达我的谢意。

english: I feel an aura of solemnity coming from you. Has it been done? Has this mistake of mine been corrected at last? $C, you have done a great deed for our people. Not only did you save us from damnation, but also showed us that the path we treaded for centuries is one the Moro'gai shouldn't follow any longer. In a way, Bhu'robi was right, the Draenei need to adapt, to ensure a new future for our people. One free of fear and instead filled with perseverance. If only he hadn't twisted the meaning of his own belief.
old_奖励清单: 你可以从这些奖励中选择其一：清明指引腰带、粗野的披风、防御者轻锤、启发可汗顾问项圈
new_译文: 我感觉你周身带着一股肃穆之气。办妥了吗？我这桩过错终于被纠正了吗？$C，你为我族人立下了大功。你不仅把我们从不祥的结局中救了出来，还让我们看清：我们沿袭了数百年的路，莫罗盖人不应再走下去了。某种意义上，布乌罗比是对的——德莱尼人必须改变，才能为族人确保一个新的未来：一个不再充满恐惧、而是充满坚韧的未来。只可惜他曲解了自己信仰的本意。

english: Bhu'robi might've been stopped, but this ordeal is far from over. Like Father said, there are still many of the Fallon Ones out there that are now lost and it is our duty to bring them back into our fold. It is a grueling task and I fear this will not be the last day we lose loved ones, but that is exactly why we have to do everything we can to prevent that from happening. While I am yet inexperienced and in training still, I will support my father and the elders as much as possible.$B$BI have thought long about it, and while I still have much to accomplish here, your actions have instilled a fire in me that I haven't felt before. For all this time we have secluded ourselves at this coast, we held ourselves back and remained hidden as best we could. But this is not how I wish my life to go. But until I have ensured the security of the village, I cannot leave. So please take this crystal. Should you be in peril, hold it to the sky and I will aid you in battle. You can count on me, $N.
old_奖励清单: 你将获得：摩洛盖之祖维尔
new_译文: 布乌罗比也许被拦下了，但这场磨难远未结束。正如父亲所说，外面还有许多失落者已经迷失，而我们有责任把他们带回族群。这是件苦差事，我怕这不会是最后一个失去亲人的日子——但正因如此，我们必须竭尽所能阻止它发生。虽然我还经验不足、仍在受训，但我会尽可能支持父亲和长老们。$B$B我想了很久。虽然我在这里还有很多事要做，但你的作为在我心里点燃了一团前所未有过的火。这么多年来，我们把自己封闭在这片海岸，压抑自己，尽可能躲藏。可这并不是我想要的人生。但在确保村子安全之前，我不能离开。所以请收下这枚水晶。若你身陷险境，把它举向天空，我会在战斗中支援你。你可以信赖我，$N。

english: What a hideous creation. Further proof that the life inside our great sanctum is rotting by the minute. Yet still, it serves a purpose. It shall pave the way for the Timbermaw to reclaim what has been torn from us by cruel malefactors. Now I can concoct a salve powerful enough to cleanse our sacred totems.$B$B$N, this humble coven expresses its gratitude towards you. Through your courage, we have made the first step in purifying Timbermaw Hold. Take this essence and use it on your delves into this den of evil. With enough of it, you may break the barrier inside and finally come to the root of it all.
old_奖励清单: 你将获得：净化精华
new_译文: 多可憎的造物。这进一步证明了我们这座圣殿中的生命正在一分一秒地腐烂。不过它仍有用途——它将为木喉铺平道路，去夺回被残暴恶徒撕走的一切。现在我能调配出足够强力的药膏，净化我们的神圣图腾了。$B$B$N，我们这小小集会向你致谢。凭你的勇气，我们朝净化木喉要塞迈出了第一步。收下这份精华，在你深入这魔物巢穴时使用。份量足够的话，你就能打破里面的结界，最终触及这一切的根源。

english: In our ancient teachings, there is a legend that connects all furbolg tribes. It speaks of our creation, as it is said the twin gods have brought us into the world as it was still young. As juvenile cubs they frolicked through the untouched wilds of Kalimdor, rolling around in the dewladen grass of the early mornings. Laughter filled the air and their unbound energy floated all around them. Bursting with their power, the droplets of the wet grass fell onto the roots of gigantic trees, seeping through the bark and becoming one with the land. Over time, these droplets grew and took the semblance of the young ursine gods.$B$BTo us furbolgs there is nothing more important than aiding our progenitors in protecting the wild. Seeing Ursol die for a second time fills my heart with anguish and pain, a being as noble as him did not deserve this fate. $N, the Timbermaw are forever in your debt. Please take this powerful salve and cleanse the remaining corruption in Timbermaw Hold.
old_奖励清单: 你将获得：永恒净化精华
new_译文: 在我们古老的教义里，有一则传说将所有熊怪部族联系在一起。它讲述了我族的诞生——据说在世界尚且年轻之时，双子神将我们带到了这个世上。那时他们还是幼崽，在卡利姆多未经触碰的荒野中嬉戏，在清晨沾满露水的草地上打滚。笑声弥漫在空气中，他们无拘无束的活力在四周飘荡。随着他们的力量满溢而出，湿草上的露珠落向巨树的根须，渗过树皮，与大地融为一体。日积月累，这些露珠逐渐生长，化作了那两位年轻熊神的模样。$B$B对我们熊怪来说，没有什么比协助始祖守护荒野更为重要。看着乌索尔第二次死去，让我的心充满痛苦与悲恸；像他这般高贵的存在，不该落得这样的下场。$N，木喉部族将永远欠你一份恩情。请收下这剂强效药膏，净化木喉要塞中残存的腐化。

english: Vortalus, you say? Worrisome to see elementals making a pact in such large numbers with the mortal races. Especially after what had happened here, at the Earthen Ring. This begs another question, however. What do the elements expect of such a coalition? Were they servants of the Blackwind tribe or was it the other way around? If the wind lords are bringing other forces under their fold, then they must be preparing for something greater.$B$B$N, thank you for your courage. You’ve done something incredible today and shown your potential as an aspiring shaman of our order. The others are surely expecting more great things from you.
old_奖励清单: 你可以从这些奖励中选择其一：大地之怒之锤、暴怒风斧类武器、淬火焰爪击
new_译文: 你说沃塔鲁斯？元素竟与凡人种族如此大规模地缔结盟约，令人担忧。尤其是在大地之环这里发生那些事之后。不过，这又引出了另一个问题：元素们究竟想从这样的联盟中得到什么？他们是黑风部族的仆从，还是反过来？若风之领主正把其他势力纳入麾下，那他们必定在为更大的图谋做准备。$B$B$N，谢谢你的勇气。你今日做到了了不起的事，也展现了作为我们教团萨满的潜力。其他人一定也期待你有更多出色表现。

english: Although there is no life left within these bones, the spores keep trying to search for nutrients, like a writhing parasite searching for prey. This is not a natural occurrence, yet it is not purely magical either. At this point it is a wholly new amalgamation of forces, and it won’t be easy to eradicate it.$B$BThe plan we have come up with is simple in concept. We will plant this tree sapling in the enriched earth you have brought us. Afterwards, we will apply the spores to the tree and observe what will happen. In our previous observations with saplings planted in plagued earth, they withered away in minutes, leaving a mutated husk behind. We assume the elementally enriched earth will protect the tree against the aggressors and allow it to grow freely. It will take a while, so if you ever come by again, maybe you are lucky enough to witness it.$B$BEither way, I must give my thanks to you, and Bewali as well. Every step taken brings us closer to healing these lands for good.
old_奖励清单: 你可以从这些奖励中选择其一：重生精力坠饰、根皮长靴、火山护心指环
new_译文: 这些骨头里已无生命，可孢子仍在不断寻找养分，像扭动的寄生虫搜寻猎物。这不是自然现象，却也不纯粹是魔法。到这一步，它已是一种全新的力量混合体，要根除它绝不容易。$B$B我们想出的办法，概念上很简单：把这株树苗种进你带来的富化土壤，然后给树施加孢子，观察会发生什么。此前我们用被瘟疫侵蚀的土壤种树苗时，它们几分钟内就枯萎，只留下一具变异的空壳。我们推测，元素富化的土壤能保护树免受侵扰，让它自由生长。这需要些时间，若你再来，说不定运气好能亲眼看到。$B$B无论如何，我得谢谢你，也谢谢贝瓦利。每一步都让我们更接近彻底治愈这片土地。
note: Bewali 库内无词条，试译「贝瓦利」

english: The elements have spoken of your return, $N. It will take time before the waters are pure again. But with no further corruption being funneled into Maraudon anymore, nature can do so in serenity and peace.$B$BTake this for your deeds in restoring balance to Azeroth.
old_奖励清单: 你可以从这些奖励中选择其一：魂水宝珠、飘忽不定之披风、泰比斯蒂亚的寒冰头冠
new_译文: 元素已经告诉我你回来了，$N。水要重新变得清澈还需要时间。但既然再没有腐化被灌入玛拉顿，自然便能从容地自我修复。$B$B这是你为艾泽拉斯重归平衡所做的贡献，收下吧。

english: Meat! And heaps of it, too! Parash’ka, who set you up for this? Or did you do it on your own volition? Either way, it hardly matters to me. With a supply like this, our defenders will have the strength to repel those heretics for days to come! A reward is needed for your actions. Here, a traditional draeneic recipe, altered to fit the cuisine of this new world.
old_奖励清单: 你将获得：食谱：浆果炸肉腿
new_译文: 肉！还这么多！帕拉什卡，是谁让你张罗这些的？还是你自己要做的？不管怎样，对我来说都一样。有了这些补给，我们的守卫就有力气再抵挡那些异端好些天！你的作为该有回报。喏，一份德莱尼传统食谱，按这新世界的口味改过。

english: Hm, I am surprised. You listened well and brought exemplary brains. The way their juices are dripping on the floor…$B$B<Fena Ma’dar is salivating at the sight of the grey matter inside your hands. With a swift movement, she snatches them out of your hand and starts chomping on them. Liquid, blood and bits fall to the floor.>$B$BI can’t get enough of this savoury taste, the slick surface, the gooey texture! It is simply wonderful! You remedied your mistake, young one. Atleast you are responsible when it comes to consequences caused by your actions. Either way, don’t cause any more ruckus around here!
old_奖励清单: 你可以从这些奖励中选择其一：长者魔杖、桀骜少年长裤、共鸣水晶头盔
new_译文: 嗯，我很意外。你听进去了，还带来了上等的脑子。看那脑浆滴在地上的样子……$B$B<费娜·玛达尔看着你手中的灰白之物，直咽口水。她动作飞快，一把从你手里夺过去，大嚼起来。汁液、血水和碎屑落在地上。>$B$B这种鲜美的滋味我怎么都吃不够——滑腻的表面，黏稠的质地！简直妙极了！你补上了你的过失，小家伙。至少对自己行为的后果，你还算负责。总之，别再在这儿惹乱子了！

english: That was a close one. Let us hope this will teach them to not come here again. I thank you endlessly for saving my life and my dear farm. You see, the earth on this coast has unique properties that make it difficult to grow crops. On top of it, the flora of your world is still difficult for me to fully grasp, even after all the time we have been here. Still, I want to reward you for your good deed. Take it, they are homegrown!
old_奖励清单: 你将获得：月语浆果、月语浆果灌木
new_译文: 好险。但愿这回能让他们长记性，不敢再来。你救了我的命和我这座宝贝农场，我感激不尽。你看，这片海岸的土壤性质特殊，作物很难生长；更何况即便待了这么久，你们世界的草木对我来说仍不易摸透。但我还是要为你的善举有所回报。拿去吧，都是自家种的！

english: So the wretch has met its end? Excellent. Twenty three of our people did this monster maul during his last rampage. With him gone, we can rest a bit more easily now.
old_奖励清单: 你可以从这些奖励中选择其一：磨利水晶指环、复仇护手、传统之长靴
new_译文: 那么那个恶棍终于伏诛了？太好了。上一次它发狂时，足足有二十三名族人死在它爪下。少了它，我们总算能睡得安稳些了。

english: The horned fiend; this satyr Selenaxx, you say? He absorbed the energy from the geode and infused his body with it, becoming one with the draenethyst?! To witness such blasphemy even in this new world. $C, the power of draenethyst is deeply alluring and requires immense willpower to not succumb to once tapped into its pulsing energy. There are… stories of Draenei falling victim to their draenethyst addiction and eventually crystalizing, ultimately becoming draenethyst themselves. Thus they return to Draenor and enter the cycle of its lifeblood.$B$BFor now, I will have to prepare the cleansing ritual for the geode shards you brought. It will take time and effort, but I and moreover the Moro’gai are deeply indebted to you. Your continued support to our tribe’s survival shall not go unrewarded. Please choose one of these bracelets, so that they may protect you against the evils yet to come.
old_奖励清单: 你可以从这些奖励中选择其一：防御者之手镯、幻像之手镯、破坏者之手镯、神谕者之手镯
new_译文: 那个长角的恶徒；你说这萨特叫塞勒娜？他吸收了晶簇的能量，注满自身，与德莱尼水晶融为了一体？！即便在这新世界，也还能见到这等亵渎之事。$C，德莱尼水晶的力量极具诱惑，一旦触及它脉动的能量，就需要极大的意志力才能不被吞没。有……些故事说，德莱尼人沉溺于水晶成瘾，最终自身晶化，自己也变成了德莱尼水晶。于是他们回到德拉诺，汇入它生命之血的循环。$B$B眼下我得为你带回的晶簇碎片准备净化仪式。这需要时间与心力，但我和莫罗盖人一样欠你太多。你对我族存续的持续支持，必将得到回报。请从这些手镯里挑一只，愿它能护你抵御将来临的邪恶。

english: Marvelous! The purest of blazes, a primordial heartbeat resonates within this inconspicuous ball of flame. No evil in this world or any other can hide from its revealing light.$B$B$N, it is time. We will erase the darkness from within Timbermaw Hold once and for all.

english: <A torn look spreads across Narkogg’s face. The corruption befalling most of our kind and one of our sacred gods has finally been quelled. All thanks to the valiant efforts of brave protectors like you. My words cannot properly convey the gratitude we have towards you and your kin. You will forever be welcome with the Timbermaw, as the cherished hero of the Furbolg.
old_奖励清单: 你将获得：神圣的木喉背包
new_译文: <纳科格脸上掠过一丝撕裂般的神情。起初你分辨不出，但从他身上传来的哀鸣与抽泣证实了你的猜测：他在哭。>$B$B历经这么多年的苦难与折磨，我的族人终于能松一口气了。笼罩我们大多数同胞、甚至我们一位神圣神灵的腐化，终于被平息。这一切都要归功于像你这样勇敢守护者的奋战。我的话无法真正表达我们对你与你的同胞的感激。你将永远是木喉的座上宾，是熊怪珍视的英雄。

english: <Brolan Windhorn lets out a deep sigh of relief.>$B$BYou have saved me much turmoil, now that I know I can sleep more at peace. You have done the Windhorn a great service this day, and I offer you a token of our appreciation outsider.

new_译文: <布罗兰风角长长地舒了一口气。>$B$B知道能睡个安稳觉，你替我免去了多少煎熬。今日你为风角一族立了大功，作为感激，我送你一件信物，外来者。

english: <Bulrok Cloudhoof takes his time inspecting the horns, tapping his finger upon the surface of the bone with curiosity.>$B$BI believe this is what I am looking for, you have done well.$B$B<The arrogant tauren lets a smirk cross his face.>$B$BHere, take this as a token of thanks from the Cloudhoof tribe.

english: <Gordnak takes his time to inspect the scale, watching it glimmer in the light, and radiate with magical energy.>$B$BIt would appear this is what I have come for. You have done well, here, take this coin, and a reward on my behalf.

english: I spent the entirety of my youth surrounded by such relics. The craftsmanship of the Windhorn is certainly superb.$B$BWithout your help, this history would have been lost to time. I thank you, for everything that you have done this day.

english: Blood for blood. You have done well, and repaid this evil with vengeance. I hope you feel the satisfaction that I feel, for I am vindicated, even if anger still burns deep in my heart.$B$BI must thank you for being the hand of my wrath. Please, take these coins, as tribute from me, and those lost.

english: <Cairne gazes upon you with a look of approval.>$B$BYou have done well, and have brought peace to the Tauren. The Deathtotem shall trouble us no longer young blood. Please, be bestowed by an item that shall bring you fortune in the days to come.

new_译文: 你依言将锁扣嵌入凹槽，它伴着一声沉重的咔哒声弹入装置。你插入钥匙不久，箱盖便打开了——收下你应得的奖赏吧。

english: Haha! You've done it, you've saved my arse!$B$BI was sure I was going to be back to Mountaineer duties if this ever got out. You've done me a real solid here, and for that you've earned something in return.$B$BOh, and don't mention this, to anyone.
old_奖励清单: 你可以从这些奖励中选择其一：驾驶员匕首、箱山脉长靴
new_译文: 哈哈！你办成了，你救了我的小命！$B$B这事要是传出去，我肯定得回去当巡山人了。你帮了我一个大忙，这份回报你受之无愧。$B$B哦，还有——这事别跟任何人提。

english: So, Ubukaz has been slain?$B$B<Granitebeard takes a moment, a smirk crossing his face.>$B$BI cannot believe my ears, I have no doubt there will be a another troll that shall rise to be chieftain, but for these coming days, peace shall be had in Dun Morogh.$B$BUntil their infighting is over, we have time to celebrate!
old_奖励清单: 你可以从这些奖励中选择其一：重型链甲护腕、启发之腰带、深线披巾
new_译文: 这么说，乌布卡兹被干掉了？$B$B<格拉尼泰比尔德顿了顿，嘴角浮现一丝笑意。>$B$B我简直不敢相信。我毫不怀疑还会有别的巨魔站出来当酋长，但接下来的这些天里，丹莫洛可以太平一阵了。$B$B趁他们内斗未了，咱们有时间好好庆贺一番！

english: Quit dawdling around! There's no time to lose, youngster.
old_奖励清单: 将对你施放以下法术：生存
new_译文: 别磨蹭了！没时间可浪费，小家伙。

english: It pains me it had to come to this, but their delusions have brought them too far away from redemption. For the sake of nature and its inhabitants, they had to return to the cycle.
old_奖励清单: 你可以从这些奖励中选择其一：烈日之绽放、监护者长靴、班达拉尔之冠、树妖根搜寻项链
new_译文: 走到这一步让我痛心，但他们的执迷已经离救赎太远。为了自然与其间的生灵，他们只能回归循环。

english: Well done. With the help of water, the Earthen Ring and you, the elements rest. Knowing that their wrath is not yet required. The mortals of Moonwhisper Coast will face its turmoil with great conviction.
old_奖励清单: 你可以从这些奖励中选择其一：大地圆环头盔、水之护腕、大地圆环便鞋
new_译文: 干得好。在水、大地之环和你的协助下，元素们归于平静——它们明白自己的怒火尚不必宣泄。月语海岸的凡人将以坚定的信念面对此地的动荡。

english: Pick. One is my for the taking, yours is the other.
old_奖励清单: 你可以从这些奖励中选择其一：召星者之颚骨、法术打击者之颚骨
new_译文: 挑吧。一件归我，另一件归你。

english: It is time to indulge in the teachings of An'she, the Right Eye of the Earthmother. Let his light illuminate your way and blind those who wish to harm the Earthmother's favored.
old_奖励清单: 将对你施放以下法术：太阳神之光
new_译文: 是时候领悟安舍的教诲了——大地母亲的右眼。愿他的光辉照亮你的前路，也灼瞎那些妄想伤害大地母亲宠儿之人的眼睛。

english: Lo'sho is often misunderstood, but he is as much a part of the Earthmother as both of her eyes. Close your eyes and listen to our people's legends.
old_奖励清单: 将对你施放以下法术：灵魂漫步
new_译文: 洛修常被误解，但他和大地母亲的双眸一样，都是她的一部分。闭上眼睛，听听我们族人的传说吧。

english: Good. This will keep us alive a while longer.$B$BDo not think this ends anything. The theft was not desperation - it was intent. They wanted to see how we would respond. Whether we were weak.$B$BNow they know better.$B$BThey will test us again. They always do. Wounded beasts grow bold when cornered. If we wait, they will gather, and they will come for us in the dark.$B$BNext time, we do not recover what was taken.$B$BNext time, we burn the hand that reaches for us.
old_奖励清单: 你可以从这些奖励中选择其一：黑根裹布、阿拉萨拉斯之盾牌
new_译文: 很好。这能让我们多撑一阵子。$B$B别以为事情就此了结。那次偷窃并非迫于绝望——那是试探。他们想看看我们会如何反应，看看我们是否软弱。$B$B现在他们知道了。$B$B他们还会再来试探，他们总是如此。受伤的野兽被逼到墙角时反而更胆大。若我们按兵不动，他们就会聚拢，然后在暗处扑上来。$B$B下一次，我们不会再追回被夺走的东西。$B$B下一次，我们要烧掉那只伸向我们的手。

english: What is this?$B$B<Andanil stares into the artifact you retrieved. His eyes linger too long, as if it is staring back.>$B$BThis is it?$B$BYes… of course it is. I see it now.$B$BThe magic is spent, drained dry, but there is no doubt. This is the source. This is what they found. Even emptied, it hums with purpose.$B$B<He lifts the object carefully, almost reverently, turning it in the light.>$B$BSuch precision. There is no waste here, no ornament for vanity’s sake. This is not elven craft.$B$BI have studied relics from every corner of our past. Highborne vaults. Pre-Sundering ruins. Nothing even approaches this. Whatever made it did not think like us. It did not feel like us. And whatever power once flowed through it was enough to drain trained arcanists in moments and leave them wandering husks.$B$BAnd still, I cannot shake the feeling that this is only a shell. A key, perhaps. Something meant to be used again.$B$BI must return to Alah’thalas at once.  Oh cousin… this time, I did not fail you.
old_奖励清单: 你可以从这些奖励中选择其一：逐日者长戟、诺克斯之长袍
new_译文: 这是什么？$B$B<阿恩达尼尔凝视着你取回的器物。他的目光停留得太久，仿佛那东西也在回望他。>$B$B就是这个？$B$B是的……当然是。现在我看清了。$B$B魔力已耗尽、被抽干，但毫无疑问。这就是源头。这就是他们找到的东西。即便已经空了，它仍因某种目的而低鸣。$B$B<他小心地举起它，近乎虔诚地在光中转了一圈。>$B$B如此精准。没有一处赘余，没有为虚荣添的纹饰。这不是精灵的工艺。$B$B我研究过我们过往各个角落的遗物：上层精灵的宝库、大分裂前的废墟——没有任何一件能与之相比。制造它的东西，思维方式与我们不同，感受方式也与我们不同。而曾流经它的力量，足以在片刻间把训练有素的奥术师抽成游荡的空壳。$B$B可我还是甩不掉一个念头：这只是一个外壳。一把钥匙，也许。是注定要再次被使用的东西。$B$B我必须立刻回阿拉萨拉斯。哦，表弟……这一次，我没有辜负你。

english: So this marks the end. Arch Druid Mothshroud is gone, and Ireth Moondancer is still alive. He meant to strike the moon out of the sky. And he almost did, were you not here to stop him. We must report this to my father, but before we do, I believe a reward is in order for all your valiant deeds.
old_奖励清单: 你可以从这些奖励中选择其一：玛拉斯埃希尔之镜片、洛修的绿松石徽记、安舍之头冠
new_译文: 那么这就结束了。大德鲁伊蛾幕死了，伊瑞丝·月舞者还活着。他本想将月亮从天上击落——若不是你出手阻止，他几乎做到了。我们必须把这件事报告给我父亲，不过在去之前，你这一路的英勇作为理应得到奖赏。

english: Our Ancestors have delivered us quite the omen, and yet I am unsure of what to make of it... Regardless, another festival has been concluded, and without your help, I would still be waiting for assistance from Moonhoof Village.$B$BI must reward you for your generosity outsider. Please, take this, on behalf of myself, and all of those in my tribe. May your travels be gentle, and the road ahead free from burden.
old_奖励清单: 你可以从这些奖励中选择其一：月蹄典礼皮坠饰、星行者指环、龙尘残留物
new_译文: 我们的祖先降下了不小的征兆，可我还不知道该如何解读……不管怎样，又一届庆典落幕了。若没有你帮忙，我恐怕还在等月蹄村的援手。$B$B外来者，我得为你的慷慨有所回报。请收下这个，代表我自己，也代表我部族中的所有人。愿你旅途平顺，前路无虞。

english: So… it truly remained there all this time.$B$B<Talanis studies the artifact in silence for a long moment.>$B$BRemarkable. The craftsmanship alone places it centuries before the founding of Zin-Azshari. And the lunar resonance… yes, I can feel it even now. This was no mere ceremonial piece. It was used. Studied. Revered. The priestesses of Elunaris must have trained beneath its light, learning to channel Elune’s blessing through it.$B$BYou have brought back more than a relic today. You have returned a fragment of our past that might otherwise have vanished with the temple itself.
old_奖励清单: 你将获得：月语搜寻项链
new_译文: 这么说……它真的一直留在那里。$B$B<塔拉尼斯沉默地端详着这件器物良久。>$B$B了不起。单凭工艺，它就能追溯到辛艾萨莉建城之前数百年。而那月光的共鸣……是的，即便此刻我也能感觉到。这绝非单纯的礼仪用器。它被使用过、被研究过、被尊崇过。艾露娜瑞斯的祭司们一定曾在它的光下修行，学习借它引导艾露恩的祝福。$B$B你今天带回的不只是一件遗物，而是我们过去的一角——否则它或许已随那座神殿一同湮灭。

english: So it is done.$B$BI take no satisfaction in this. Still… if they had been left unchecked, more would have died. We will keep watch on the rest of their tribes. If this corruption spreads, we will know. Until then, Narvalis Point remains secure. That is what matters.
old_奖励清单: 你将获得：克瑞西斯的靴子
new_译文: 那就这样结束了。$B$B我并无快意。只是……若放任不管，死的人会更多。我们会继续盯着他们其余的部族——若这腐化继续蔓延，我们就会知道。在那之前，纳尔瓦利斯角是安全的。这才是要紧的事。

english: Lady Serpentia… and Ta’jax as well.$B$B<For the first time, Silverstreak allows herself a small, satisfied nod.>$B$BGood. Very good.$B$BWithout them, the Tideblade will splinter into rival broods. Naga are not known for unity when strong leaders are absent. That gives us the advantage. The ruins of Nendis may finally know peace again.$B$BThe High Priestess should hear of it.
old_奖励清单: 你可以从这些奖励中选择其一：月光锁甲、月步护腿
new_译文: 塞彭提亚女士……还有塔贾克斯。$B$B<银痕头一次允许自己露出一个心满意足的点头。>$B$B很好。非常好。$B$B没了他们，潮刃会分裂成互相敌对的几支。纳迦在缺少强势领袖时，素来谈不上团结。这给了我们优势。奈迪斯废墟或许终于能重归安宁了。$B$B这件事该让高阶祭司知道。

english: Lady Serpentia and Ta’jax are dead?$B$BThose names were spoken often during the war against Illidan. Their warbands left scars along this coast that have not yet faded. If they have truly fallen, then one of the last shadows from that time has finally been lifted.$B$BNendis has been silent for far too long. With the naga driven out, the ruins may finally be reclaimed. Not quickly. Wounds like these take time to heal. But in time… our people will return. Homes will be rebuilt. Temples restored. The forests will hear our voices again.$B$BMoonwhisper Coast was once a place where the kaldorei lived in peace beneath Elune’s light. Perhaps, slowly, it may become so again.$B$BYou have helped make that future possible, $C. Know that the sentinels of Narvalis Point have my gratitude… and so do you.
old_奖励清单: 你将获得：南迪斯之希望
new_译文: 塞彭提亚女士和塔贾克斯都死了？$B$B在对抗伊利丹的战争里，这两个名字常被提起。他们的战团在这片海岸留下的伤疤至今未愈。若他们真的倒下，那个时代最后的阴影之一便终于散去了。$B$B奈迪斯沉寂得太久了。纳迦被赶走后，废墟或许终于能重归。不会很快——这样的创伤需要时间愈合。但随着时间……我的人民会回来。家园会重建，神殿会修复，森林将再次听到我们的声音。$B$B月语海岸曾是卡多雷在艾露恩之光下安居乐业之地。也许，慢慢地，它会再度如此。$B$B$C，你帮助这个未来成为可能。纳尔瓦利斯角的哨兵们感激你……我也一样。

english: Starcaller is dead?$B$BGood. That removes the most immediate obstacle.$B$BThe blue dragonflight rarely commits to guarding something so aggressively unless it carries great arcane significance.$B$BA meteor saturated with arcane energy… and dragons circling it like vultures.$B$BYes. There is definitely more to this crater than a simple rock from the sky. With that drake gone, perhaps the others will grow less bold. Or perhaps they will become curious enough to reveal what they were truly protecting.$B$BEither way, you have given us an opportunity to learn the truth.$B$BAnd I very much intend to take it.
old_奖励清单: 你将获得：屠龙者
new_译文: 召星者死了？$B$B很好。最紧迫的障碍就此清除。$B$B蓝龙军团很少如此凶悍地守卫某样东西——除非它蕴藏着极大的奥术意义。$B$B一颗浸透奥术能量的陨石……还有巨龙像秃鹫般在它周围盘旋。$B$B没错。这个陨坑里绝不止一颗坠自天上的石头那么简单。那条龙死了，其余的可能也会收敛些胆量。又或者，它们会好奇到把真正守护的东西亮出来。$B$B无论如何，你给了我们查明真相的机会。$B$B而我非常想抓住它。

english: So the grove has been quieted… for now.$B$BI hoped the corruption had not spread this far, but the signs are unmistakable. These druids no longer serve the balance of the wilds. Something has guided them down this path.$B$BThe Grove of the Sun on the Isle of Tyrandas may hold answers. One of my allies tends the groves there.$B$BSeek out Sister Mirallun. She watches the forest more closely than most. Tell her what you have seen.
old_奖励清单: 你将获得：星玻璃眼镜
new_译文: 这么说，林地安静下来了……暂时而已。$B$B我本希望腐化没有蔓延到这一步，但迹象再清楚不过。这些德鲁伊已不再侍奉荒野的平衡。有什么东西引导他们走上了这条路。$B$B泰兰达斯岛的日之林地也许有答案——我的一位盟友在那照看林地。$B$B去找米拉鲁恩姊妹吧。她比大多数人更仔细地守望着森林。把你看到的都告诉她。
